items.name: Hydrocarbons
items.description: Raw fossil fuels such as petroleum and mineral oil. Hydrocarbons are crucial building blocks in the production of organic chemicals, plastics and waxes, and are thus one of the most useful materials harvestable from any source.

items.name: Atmospheric Gases
items.description: Nitrogen, oxygen, neon, helium, xenon, methane, nitrous oxide, ozone - a host of trapped vapours that can be used to catalyze numerous chemical processes.

items.name: Evaporite Deposits
items.description: Deposits formed by the precipitation of mineral-rich water. Usable for many purposes, mostly as building-block components for more complex materials.

items.name: Silicates
items.description: Various types of silicon-based and oxygen-based rock formations.

items.name: Tungsten
items.description: One of the hardest metals in existence. Able to form extremely durable alloys with various other elements, and very useful in a number of deep-space scenarios.

items.name: Titanium
items.description: An extremely fatigue-resistant yet light-weight metallic element, useful as a refractory metal and employable in a wide variety of potential scenarios. One of the primary building blocks of a whole host of materials.

items.name: Scandium
items.description: A transition element harnessed from rare minerals, Scandium commonly sees use as a component of high-intensity light fixtures for deep-space environments, as well as being a strong building block in many deep-space structures and spacecraft due to its extremely high melting point.

items.name: Cobalt
items.description: A silvery ferromagnetic element, used among other things in superalloys, magnetics, battery electrodes, and various metals and steels.

items.name: Chromium
items.description: A steel-gray, lustrous metal with a wide variety of applications. Commonly used as a catalyst for chemical processes.

items.name: Vanadium
items.description: A soft, white metal with a wide-ranging arsenal of applications both nuclear and structural. Also a versatile catalyst in compound form.

items.name: Cadmium
items.description: A soft, malleable metal often occuring with zinc ores. Has a wide variety of applications; used in electroplating, superconductors, and as an alloy in various types of structure and equipment.

items.name: Platinum
items.description: A corrosion-resistant precious metal with an extremely wide range of applications. Often used as a chemical catalyst.

items.name: Mercury
items.description: Also known as quicksilver, mercury is a silvery liquid metal whose primary characteristic is the ease with which it forms amalgamatic alloys with other metals. It is therefore extremely useful as a base-block component.

items.name: Caesium
items.description: A golden Alkali metal used primarily in propulsion systems. Also performs a variety of catalytic functions in the nuclear and photoelectric arenas.

items.name: Hafnium
items.description: A silvery, corrosion-resistant metal used in various metal alloys and, to a lesser extent, in hybrid weapons systems.

items.name: Technetium
items.description: A silvery metal, primarily used as a corrosion inhibitor and a superconductor.

items.name: Dysprosium
items.description: A relatively rare soft metal, easily dissolvable in mineral acids. Used primarily in the production of laser materials.

items.name: Neodymium
items.description: A rare, silvery metal. Due to its atmospheric reactiveness, Neodymium is used primarily for light-refractive purposes and as a colorant for other materials.

items.name: Promethium
items.description: An extremely radioactive luminescent metal, sometimes used as a heating component and a building block for laser generators.

items.name: Thulium
items.description: A soft, rare, silvery-gray metal. Used in the creation of lasers, in addition to possessing a range of radiation-related production applications.

items.name: Titanium Chromide
items.description: Titanium Chromide is in high demand among technicians and manufacturers for its unique combination of strength, light weight and catalytic potential.

items.name: Crystallite Alloy
items.description: A polynuclear heterometallic compound created from cobalt and cadmium. Crystallite alloys are a fundamental building block in the creation of crystalline composites.

items.name: Fernite Alloy
items.description: An intensely durable and extremely versatile alloy, Fernite, when combined with certain other materials, is a crucial stepping stone in the creation of a whole host of advanced technologies.

items.name: Rolled Tungsten Alloy
items.description: An extremely strong compound, made from tungsten rolled in a sheath of platinum. A crucial component in the creation of carbides which have a wide field of utility in the manufacture of various equipment.

items.name: Silicon Diborite
items.description: A mineral composite which, in large quantities, gives off a distinct crystalline glow. When combined with other composites, is usable for a variety of manufacturing purposes.

items.name: Carbon Polymers
items.description: A synthetic carbon compound created from raw hydrocarbons and silicate rock materials. Important ingredients in a variety of carbon- and gel-based composites.

items.name: Ceramic Powder
items.description: A fine powder synthesized from various natural gases and solids through reactant processes. Used as a strengthening agent in both armor plating and shield generators, as well as constituting an important part of many other composite materials.

items.name: Sulfuric Acid
items.description: A strong mineral acid, used in many chemical reactions and production processes. One of the most widely used chemicals in history.

items.name: Platinum Technite
items.description: An intensely resilient alloy composed of platinum and technetium. Highly sought-after in the machinery and armament industries.

items.name: Caesarium Cadmide
items.description: A dark-golden hued alloy composed of cadmium and caesium. Often confused with tritanium due to its tint. An essential ingredient in various composites and condensates.

items.name: Solerium
items.description: When chromium and caesium are combined with raw silicates in the proper proportions, Solerium is created. Since its initial discovery, Solerium's uniquely shifting dark-to-bright red hue has prompted poet and musician alike to create hymns in praise of its uniquely shifting deep red hue.

items.name: Hexite
items.description: A chemical compound, formed through electrosporadic oxidization of chromium and platinum.  Has a wide range of applications in the production of advanced technology and is highly sought-after by industrial manufacturers.

items.name: Hyperflurite
items.description: Hyperflurite is one of the most radioactive substances known to man. Composed of a mixture of radioactive metals and raw hydrocarbons, this luminescent goop provides catalysis for a variety of generative and reactive machine processes.

items.name: Neo Mercurite
items.description: A silvery, shimmering liquid compound, Neo Mercurite is a crucial element in many forms of advanced sensor and processor technology.

items.name: Dysporite
items.description: Quicksilver mixed with dysprosium forms the soft but extremely resilient dysporite, an amalgamatic alloy which plays a key role in most advanced sensor and reactor technologies.

items.name: Ferrofluid
items.description: Ferrofluids are superparamagnetic fluids containing tiny particles of magnetic solids suspended in liquid. The primary component in the creation of ferrogels.

items.name: Crystalline Carbonide
items.description: An exceptionally hard material created from crystallite alloys and carbon polymers, crystalline carbonite is a primary component in various forms of advanced Gallente technology, such as thrusters and armor plating.

items.name: Titanium Carbide
items.description: Due to its immense strength and molecular malleability, Titanium Carbide has become the darling of the Caldari technological industry, seeing use in everything from reactor units to weapons systems.

items.name: Tungsten Carbide
items.description: Tungsten Carbide is a much-used composite, greatly favored by the Amarrians for construction of their advanced technologies.

items.name: Fernite Carbide
items.description: A revolutionary ceramic carbide compound, much favored by the Matari both for its earthy quality and its extremely wide range of technological uses.

items.name: Sylramic Fibers
items.description: Extremely strong fibers, used in laminated armor plating.

items.name: Fullerides
items.description: Fullerides are highly superconductive materials used in capacitors, armor plating and weapons systems.

items.name: Phenolic Composites
items.description: A extremely heat-resistant material used in thrusters and as heat shielding.

items.name: Nanotransistors
items.description: Extremely complex molecular-level transistors used in nanoscale electronics, such as microprocessors and capacitor units.

items.name: Hypersynaptic Fibers
items.description: Whenever the transmission of visual or numerical data is a matter of life and death, the data network needs the fastest possible relay system. Hypersynaptic fibers, due to their immense frequency range and speed of conduction, have become the industry standard for sensor arrays and targeting systems.

items.name: Ferrogel
items.description: A magnetised liquid, used to control the flow of cold plasma fields in shield systems, reactor cores, pulse generators and thruster systems.

items.name: Manufacturing Tools
items.description: Tools used in various construction projects, such as ship, module or ground vehicle manufacturing.

items.name: Medium Artillery Battery
items.description: Fires a barrage of large projectiles at those the Control Tower deems its enemies. Very effective at long-range bombardment and packs a punch, but lacks the speed to track fast and up-close targets effectively.

items.name: Large Artillery Battery
items.description: Fires a barrage of extra large projectiles at those the Control Tower deems its enemies. Extremely effective at long-range bombardment and hits hard, but lacks the speed to track fast and up-close targets.

items.name: Small Railgun Battery
items.description: Fires a barrage of medium hybrid slugs at those the Control Tower deems its enemies. Provides high damage output and is effective at long ranges.

items.name: Medium Railgun Battery
items.description: Fires a barrage of large hybrid slugs at those the Control Tower deems its enemies. Provides high damage output and is effective at long ranges.

items.name: Large Railgun Battery
items.description: Fires a barrage of extra large hybrid slugs at those the Control Tower deems its enemies. Provides high damage output and is effective at long ranges.

items.name: Enhanced Training Drone
items.description: This weak but hostile training drone allows rookie-pilots to experience combat without too much risk. This is the enhanced version of the original Training Drone prototype. Threat level: Very low

items.name: Large Beam Laser Battery
items.description: Fires a deep modulated energy beam using extra large sized frequency crystals at those the Control Tower deems its enemies. Effective at very long ranges, but tracks slowly and has a low rate of fire. Note: Placing a new type of crystal into the crystal compartment will result in the destruction of the crystal being replaced.

items.name: Heavy Missile Battery
items.description: A launcher array designed to fit heavy missiles. Fires at those the Control Tower deems its enemies.

items.name: Cruise Missile Battery
items.description: A launcher array designed to fit cruise missiles. Fires at those the Control Tower deems its enemies.

items.name: Torpedo Battery
items.description: A launcher array designed to fit torpedos. Fires at those the Control Tower deems its enemies.

items.name: Vivian Menure
items.description: A member of a team of gladiators which make their living off nationwide Gladiator shows.  Threat level: Moderate

items.name: Uenia Khann
items.description: A member of a team of gladiators which make their living off nationwide Gladiator shows. Threat level: Very high

items.name: Mullok Bloodsworn
items.description: Blood Raider Commanders have mastered the Rites of Blood, giving them unnatural affinity with all things living. Threat level: Deadly.

items.name: Javvyn Bloodsworn
items.description: Blood Raider Commanders have mastered the Rites of Blood, giving them unnatural affinity with all things living. Threat level: Deadly.

items.name: Terror Bloodsworn
items.description: Blood Raider Commanders have mastered the Rites of Blood, giving them unnatural affinity with all things living. Threat level: Very high

items.name: Mordur Bloodsworn
items.description: Blood Raider Commanders have mastered the Rites of Blood, giving them unnatural affinity with all things living. Threat level: Very high

items.name: Novice Medal
items.description: A medal awarded to those that have completed the Novice Trial of the Legends Trials.

items.name: Intermediate Medal
items.description: A medal awarded to those that have completed the Intermediate Trial of the Legends Trials.

items.name: Legends Medal
items.description: A medal awarded to those that have completed the final trial of the Legends Trials. Only the greatest combat pilots of the Eve universe can claim to have accomplished this great feat.

items.name: Ammo_Container
items.description: The wrecked container drifts silently amongst the stars, giving no hint to what treasures it may hide.

items.name: Armor_Container

items.name: Rogue Drone Container
items.description: The drone-built container drifts silently amongst the stars, giving no hint to what treasures it may hide.

items.name: weapon_container
items.description: The wrecked container drifts silently amongst the stars, giving no hint to what treasures it may hide.

items.name: Amarr Cathedral
items.description: This impressive structure operates as a place for religious practice and the throne of a high ranking member within the clergy.

items.name: Blood Raider Cathedral
items.description: This impressive structure operates as a place for religious practice and the throne of a high ranking member within the clergy.

items.name: Asteroid Installation
items.description: Where geographical conditions allow, outposts such as this one are a good way of increasing the effectiveness of deep-space mining operations.

items.name: Cargo Rig
items.description: This industrial structure serves as a platform for warehouses and the sorting of cargo containers.

items.name: Amarr Chapel
items.description: This decorated structure serves as a place for religious practice.

items.name: Blood Raider Chapel
items.description: This decorated structure serves as a place for religious practice.

items.name: Drone Structure II
items.description: This gigantic superstructure was built by the effort of thousands of rogue drones. While the structure appears to be incomplete, its intended shape remains a mystery to clueless carbon-based lifeforms.

items.name: Drone Structure I
items.description: This gigantic superstructure was built by the effort of thousands of rogue drones. While the structure appears to be incomplete, its intended shape remains a mystery to the clueless carbon-based lifeforms.

items.name: Partially constructed Megathron
items.description: This Megathron battleship is partially complete, with decks and inner-hull systems exposed to the cold of surrounding space.

items.name: Landing Pad
items.description: This outpost has a docking pad designed to receive and process large shipments of cargo.

items.name: Infested Station Ruins
items.description: To speed up the construction process of rogue drone structures, certain strains of drones have been known to salvage the ruins of their defeated enemies, using them either as a base or to slowly dissolve them into their desired final shape. This particular object seems to be a Gallente station and two Megathron battleships, partially broken down into a construction lattice around an asteroid.

items.name: Ruined Stargate
items.description: This ruined stargate has at least a few internal power generators left but is nevertheless currently inoperational, unable to serve its intended function of hurling starships to distant solar systems.

items.name: Solar Harvester
items.description: This gigantic construction uses electromagnetic conductors to harvest solar power from the system's sun.

items.description: Amarr tachyon beam sentry

items.name: Tower Sentry Angel III
items.description: Angel 1400mm howitzer sentry

items.description: Blood Raider tachyon beam sentry

items.description: Caldari 425mm railgun sentry

items.description: Gallente ion blaster cannon sentry

items.name: Radio Telescope
items.description: This huge radio telescope contains fragile but advanced sensory equipment. A structure such as this has enormous capabilities in crunching survey data from nearby systems and constellations.

items.name: Sansha Data Sheets
items.description: Secrent documents used by the Sansha's Nation.

items.name: Amarr Deadspace Refiner
items.description: Built to reprocess ores into minerals without the tedious interlude of a station visit. All for the glory of the Emperor and the prominence of the Amarr Empire.

items.name: Amarr Deadspace Repair Unit
items.description: The Amarr Empire spreads far and wide and the presence of repair outposts at strategic locations ensures the will of the Emperor prevails in its every far flung corner.

items.name: Amarr Deadspace Tactical Unit
items.description: Feudal obligations in the Amarr Empire force every lord loyal to the Emperor to participate in the defense of the realm. Tactical outposts serve as the backbone to the first line of defense the empire enjoys.

items.name: Asteroid Factory
items.description: Highly vulnerable, but economically extremely feasible, asteroid factories are one of the major boons of the expanding space industry.

items.name: Asteroid Colony
items.description: Highly vulnerable, but economically extremely feasible, asteroid factories are one of the major boons of the expanding space industry.

items.name: Asteroid Construct
items.description: Carving out asteroids to act as habitats for miners and manufacturers is a cheap and efficient way to quickly cash in on the insatiable needs of the space industry.

items.name: Asteroid Prime Colony
items.description: Carving out asteroids to act as habitats for miners and manufacturers is a cheap and efficient way to quickly cash in on the insatiable needs of the space industry.

items.name: Asteroid Structure
items.description: Carving out asteroids to act as habitats for miners and manufacturers is a cheap and efficient way to quickly cash in on the insatiable needs of the space industry.

items.name: Asteroid Secondary Colony
items.description: Carving out asteroids to act as habitats for miners and manufacturers is a cheap and efficient way to quickly cash in on the insatiable needs of the space industry.

items.name: Meat Popsicle
items.description: The inhospitability of space no longer bothers this individual.

items.name: Asteroid Colony Tower
items.description: This is a building dedicated to offices and staff quarters mostly, though spacious halls and special installments allow for some flexibility in function.

items.name: Asteroid Micro-Colony
items.description: Carving out asteroids to act as habitats for miners and manufacturers is a cheap and efficient way to quickly cash in on the insatiable needs of the space industry.

items.name: Empty Station Battery
items.description: Forlorn hulk of a depleted station battery. Once a vital part of the complex, it now only serves to remind us that in space the only thing eternal is death.

items.name: Deadspace Particle Accelerator
items.description: The science allowed by zero gravity can be as mind-boggling as it is beautiful, as demonstrated by this particle accelerating superstructure.

items.name: Caldari Deadspace Refining Outpost
items.description: The Caldari State was the first to employ ore refineries outside space stations, a natural move for an entity that values efficiency above everything else.

items.name: Caldari Deadspace Repair Outpost
items.description: First used during the Gallente-Caldari War, "the black smithy," as it is fondly called by the Caldari Navy, has since saved countless numbers of pilots the indignity of a disintegrating ship.

items.name: Caldari Deadspace Tactical Outpost
items.description: These structures saw heavy use during the days of the Gallente-Caldari war.  Built to allow the State's Navy vessels the opportunity to make fortified pit stops in otherwise sparsely populated areas, they were also a tremendous help in pushing back the battle lines.

items.name: Circle Construct
items.description: A massive circular construction, made of a reinforced tritanium alloy.

items.name: Pulsating Sensor
items.description: Built for up-to-the-minute analysis of tactical and environmental data, these outposts can be found dotted around many a deadspace complex.

items.name: Gallentean Deadspace Outpost
items.description: Equally equipped for scientific observation and entertainment of all sorts, these multi-purpose structures, while not quite big enough to be classified as stations, nonetheless see quite a bit of use by both tourists and professionals.

items.name: Pressure Silo
items.description: Built to withstand assault, these behemoths can each hold roughly 8.5 million m3 worth of materials.

items.name: Minmatar Deadspace Refining Outpost
items.description: Though built cheaply, this refinery is able to process most ores at the same level of efficiency found on any station-based refinery platform.

items.name: Minmatar Deadspace Repair Outpost
items.description: Due to their amazing cost-effectiveness and the speed at which they can be built, these outposts are seeing greater and greater use among Matari freedom fighters and other warriors and travelers who need to be able to stay mobile in dangerous territory.

items.name: Minmatar Deadspace Tactical Outpost
items.description: Outfitted with makeshift sensor arrays and second-hand tactical data analysis equipment, these outposts will, to anyone not in the know, look like useless scrapyards.  Which is exactly what the Matari would have you think.

items.name: Freight Pad
items.description: Built for up-to-the-minute analysis of tactical and environmental data, these pads can be found dotted around many a deadspace complex.

items.name: Subspace Frequency Generator
items.description: Utilizing advanced auto-locomotive electrocardic subroutines, this miniscule generator is able to generate power equal to far bigger versions of older models.

items.name: Blasted Neon Sign
items.description: Once the pride and joy of its parent corporation, this broken-down heap of neon and metal is now no more than a symbolic manifestation of capitalistic decline.

items.name: Low-Tech Deadspace Energy Harvester
items.description: Containing only a handful of mechanical components, this simple wonder harvests energy from the system's sun by virtue of the unique EM refractive qualities in its scartate fabric.

items.name: Rapid Pulse Sentry
items.description: Emitting a high-frequency electromagnetic pulse, this scanner sentry is able to assimilate and store environmental data with remarkable efficiency.  Particularly effective at picking up miniscule fluctuations in the particle field within its range.

items.name: Magnetic Retainment Field
items.description: This bubble was built around a subspace ionization convergence.  Its main purpose is to contain the energy emanating from the convergence until a way can be found to properly harness it.

items.name: Complex Reactor Array
items.description: This structure has been automatically disabled by CONCORD to make way for newer replacement technology.

items.name: Captain Numek Kradin
items.description: This is a CONCORD Special Ops Captain.  Consider him a threat to anyone that has commited a criminal offense within CONCORD patrolled space.

items.name: General Krayek Tsunomi
items.description: This is a General within the CONCORD Army.  Consider him a threat to anyone that has commited a criminal offense within CONCORD patrolled space.

items.name: Captain Jym Muntoya
items.description: This is a captain within the CONCORD Army.  Consider him a threat to anyone that has commited a criminal offense within CONCORD patrolled space.

items.name: Gistii Ambusher
items.description: This is a fighter for the Arch Angels. It is protecting the assets of Arch Angels and may attack anyone it perceives as a threat or easy pickings. Threat level: High

items.name: Gistum Depredator
items.description: This is a fighter for the Arch Angels. It is protecting the assets of Arch Angels and may attack anyone it perceives as a threat or easy pickings. Threat level: Extreme

items.name: Gistii Fugitive
items.description: This is a fighter for the Arch Angels. It is protecting the assets of Arch Angels and may attack anyone it perceives as a threat or easy pickings. Threat level: Very low

items.name: Gistii Hijacker
items.description: This is a fighter for the Arch Angels. It is protecting the assets of Arch Angels and may attack anyone it perceives as a threat or easy pickings. Threat level: Very low

items.name: Gistii Hunter

items.name: Stargate under construction and repair
items.description: The construction of a stargate within a Deadspace Complex has not yet been successful due to environmental factors. But the Angel Corporation is obviously trying...

items.name: Ukomi Superconductors
items.description: Highly isolated coils with minimal friction, used in high-voltage electrical devices. The Ukomi Superconductors are a new brand developed and manufactured by the Kaalakiota corporation. Today every Caldari station has a stockpile of these highly rated Superconductors, which are in quite high demand in most foreign black markets due to their superior technology.

items.name: Augmented Angel Battlestation
items.description: This gigantic suprastructure is one of the military installations of the Angel pirate corporation. Even for its size, it has no commercial station services or docking bay to receive guests.

items.name: Security Outpost
items.description: This outpost is the base of security operations in this deadspace complex's inner perimeter.

items.name: Tritan - The Underground Overseer
items.description: Inside this Deadspace Complex, the focus of attention seems to be this imposing battleship. An unusual glow makes the hull shimmer from time to time.

items.name: The Battlestation Admiral
items.description: This elite Domination Defense General has been stationed here for some unannounced purpose. Sits and waits...

items.name: Gallentean Planetary Vehicles
items.description: Tracked, wheeled and hover vehicles used within planetary atmosphere for personal and business use. Gallentean vehicles (or the 'luxury edition' as they are sometimes called) have been specially modified with numerous gadgets to make the ride more comfortable, and enjoyable. A high-tech personal entertainment system has been put in all of the passenger seats, the seats have been made far more comfy, etc.

items.name: Control Headquarters
items.description: This looks much like a standard cruiser fighting for the Angel Cartel, but somehow that one looks slightly foreboding.

items.name: Security Coordinator
items.description: This looks much like a standard cruiser fighting for the Angel Cartel, but this one's weapon module glisten and gleam in an uncanny way.

items.name: Small Beam Laser Battery
items.description: Fires a deep modulated energy beam using medium sized frequency crystals at those the Control Tower deems its enemies. Effective at relatively long ranges, but tracks fairly slowly and has a low rate of fire. Note: Placing a new type of crystal into the crystal compartment will result in the destruction of the crystal being replaced.

items.name: Medium Beam Laser Battery
items.description: Fires a deep modulated energy beam using large sized frequency crystals at those the Control Tower deems its enemies. Effective at long ranges, but tracks relatively slowly and has a low rate of fire. Note: Placing a new type of crystal into the crystal compartment will result in the destruction of the crystal being replaced.

items.name: Ion Field Projection Battery
items.description: Projects a low intensity field of ionized particles to disrupt the effectivenes of enemy sensors. Very effective against Magnetometric-based sensors.

items.name: Phase Inversion Battery
items.description: Analyzes incoming targeting signals and attempts to counter them by emitting an out-of-phase signal back. Great against Ladar targeting systems.

items.name: Spatial Destabilization Battery
items.description: Projects random bursts of gravitons that disrupt accurate targeting. As expected this system works best against Gravimetric targeting systems.

items.name: White Noise Generation Battery
items.description: Disrupts enemy targeting by generating a field of random sensor noise. Works especially well against Radar systems.

items.name: Stasis Webification Battery
items.description: The webifier's big brother. Designed to protect structures from fast-moving ships by making them into slow-moving ships.

items.name: UNUSED_Gist_Battlestation_LCS_ID31_DL1_DCP1
items.description: This gigantic suprastructure is one of the military installations of the Angel pirate corporation. Even for it's size it has no commercial station services or docking bay to receive guests.

items.name: Sensor Dampening Battery
items.description: Deployable structure that cycle dampens enemy sensors.

items.name: Warp Disruption Battery
items.description: Deployable warp jamming structure.

items.name: Warp Scrambling Battery
items.description: Deployable warp jamming structure.

items.name: Ballistic Deflection Array
items.description: Boosts the control tower's shield resistance against kinetic damage. Using more than one unit of this structure or similar structures that affect the same attribute on the control tower will yield diminishing returns.

items.name: Explosion Dampening Array
items.description: Boosts the control tower's shield resistance against explosive damage. Using more than one unit of this structure or similar structures that affect the same attribute on the control tower will yield diminishing returns.

items.name: Heat Dissipation Array
items.description: Boosts the control tower's shield resistance against thermal damage. Using more than one unit of this structure or similar structures that affect the same attribute on the control tower will yield diminishing returns.

items.name: Photon Scattering Array
items.description: Boosts the control tower's shield resistance against EM damage. Using more than one unit of this structure or similar structures that affect the same attribute on the control tower will yield diminishing returns.

items.name: Force Field Array
items.description: Projects a password protected force field around structures that are outside the range of a control tower's shields.

items.name: Fermionic Condensates
items.description: One of the most complex composites known to man, fermionic condensates consist of superconductive boson particles all occupying the same quantum state, thus creating a nearly resistance-free environment for electric current. These condensates have therefore become a staple in advanced reactor manufacture.

items.description: This is a Station Container. It is fitted with a password-protected security lock and computerized inventory auditing. Although the construction of a Station Container is much like that of other Cargo Containers a Station Container is far too big to fit in a ship's cargo hold and is only used for storage and inventory management at stations.

items.description: This Blood Raider outpost looks as if it could hold some surprises...

items.name: Sansha Deadspace Outpost I
items.description: Containing an inner habitation core surrounded by an outer shell filled with a curious fluid, the purpose of which remains unclear, this outpost is no doubt the brain-child of some nameless True Slave engineer.

items.name: Guristas Deadspace Tactical Outpost
items.description: This structure was originally built by the Caldari State and was intended to go to Mordu's Legion as part of a surplus shipment, but the convoy was intercepted by a Gurista strike force in what has become famously known as the "Pure Blind Bonanza."  Aside from a different coat of paint and an added layer of armor plating, this outpost looks just like its Caldari counterpart.

items.name: UNUSED_Gist_Bunker_LCS_ID104_DL5_DCP1
items.description: This gigantic suprastructure has been fitted with internal docking bays to receive the guests visiting this pleasure resort. It is a popular chill-out spot for weary smugglers.

items.description: Ulamon's Data Chip.

items.name: Data Chips
items.description: A small wafer of semiconductor material that forms the base for an integrated circuit.

items.name: Bloodsport Arena
items.description: To escape the jurisdiction of those who would curb their entertainments, full-contact fight promoters and unlicensed, duel-to-the-death Clash Masters have taken to setting up these deep-space arenas for their brutal games to take place in.  A hive of scum and villainy -- or, alternatively, a wonderland of sport and blood-stained jollity.

items.name: Habitation Module - Brothel
items.description: The architectural design for the CreoDron Habitation Module started out as a contract deal from the Expert Housing Corporation to standardize the modular drifter homes normally used by miners and deep space explorers. When the project was cancelled due to insufficient funding, CreoDron utilized their design for the open market as high-orbit department buildings for commercial use. The marketing was a tremendous hit, making the Habitation Module a common sight across the universe. Common uses include anything from bars, casinos and brothels, to police stations and interrogation facilities.

items.name: Large Blaster Battery
items.description: Fires a barrage of extra large hybrid slugs at those the Control Tower deems its enemies. Only effective at fairly close ranges, but extremely deadly in terms of sheer damage output.

items.name: Medium Blaster Battery
items.description: Fires a barrage of large hybrid slugs at those the Control Tower deems its enemies. Only effective at fairly close ranges, but very deadly in terms of sheer damage output.

items.name: Small Blaster Battery
items.description: Fires a barrage of medium hybrid slugs at those the Control Tower deems its enemies. Only effective at fairly close ranges, but deadly in terms of sheer damage output.

items.name: Large Pulse Laser Battery
items.description: Fires a pulsed energy beam using extra large sized frequency crystals at those the Control Tower deems its enemies. Effective at fairly long ranges, tracks moderately fast and has a higher rate of fire than its beam laser counterpart. Note: Placing a new type of crystal into the crystal compartment will result in the destruction of the crystal being replaced.

items.name: Medium Pulse Laser Battery
items.description: Fires a pulsed energy beam using large sized frequency crystals at those the Control Tower deems its enemies. Effective at fairly long ranges, tracks fast and has a higher rate of fire than its beam laser counterpart. Note: Placing a new type of crystal into the crystal compartment will result in the destruction of the crystal being replaced.

items.name: Small Pulse Laser Battery
items.description: Fires a pulsed energy beam using medium sized frequency crystals at those the Control Tower deems its enemies. Effective only at relatively short range, but tracks very fast and has a higher rate of fire than any other laser battery. Note: Placing a new type of crystal into the crystal compartment will result in the destruction of the crystal being replaced.

items.name: Former Slaves
items.description: These former slaves have been cleanched of their Vitoc dependancy.

items.name: Phi-Operation Protector
items.description: This ominous battleship has been modified somewhat. It is at the approximate center of this Deadspace Pocket.

items.name: Captain Rouge
items.description: If Angel's Red Light District really is the den of carnal pleasures, then this would be the head pimp.

items.name: Angels Retirement Home
items.description: This is where elderly Angel Cartel members are supposed to enjoy the last few years of existence. It is popular amongst them to bring with them memorabilia from past conquests and even work on some projects in the quiet and solitude of the Deadspace Complexes.

items.name: Gallente 106 Election Holoreel
items.description: This holoreel contains most of the advertisements used in the Gallente propoganda machine for each of the candidates vying for the presidency, as well as a detailed biography of each person.

items.name: Amarrian Wheat
items.description: Cereal grasses have been localized on hundreds of worlds. The grains of the wheat plant make a solid foundation for the production of foodstuffs within empire space. Amarrian Wheat is known for its purity, and has reputedly never been tampered with by genetic engineering.

items.name: Crimson Arkonor
items.description:
While fairly invisible to all but the most experienced miners, there are significant molecular differences between arkonor and its crimson counterpart, so-named because of the blood-red veins running through it. Miners who search for this diamond in the rough will be rewarded with mineral yields 5% higher than standard arkonor.

Arkonor is one of the rarest and most sought-after ores in the known universe. A sizable nugget of this can sweep anyone from rags to riches in no time. It has high amount of Megacyte, and also contains some Mexallon and Pyerite.

Available primarily in null security status and wormhole systems.

items.name: Prime Arkonor
items.description:
Prime arkonor is the rarest of the rare; the king of ores. Giving a 10% greater mineral yield than regular arkonor, this is the stuff that makes billionaires out of people lucky enough to stumble upon a vein.

Arkonor is one of the rarest and most sought-after ores in the known universe. A sizable nugget of this can sweep anyone from rags to riches in no time. It has high amount of Megacyte, and also contains some Mexallon and Pyerite.

Available primarily in null security status and wormhole systems.

items.name: Triclinic Bistot
items.description:
Bistot with a triclinic crystal system occurs very rarely under natural conditions, but is highly popular with miners due to its extra-high concentrations of minerals. The yield from triclinic bistot is approximately 5% higher than from equivalent volumes of standard bistot.

Bistot is a very valuable ore as it holds large portions of Zydrine and Pyerite. It also contains a decent amount of Mexallon.

Available primarily in null security status and wormhole systems.

items.name: Monoclinic Bistot
items.description:
Monoclinic bistot is a variant of bistot with a slightly different crystal structure. It is highly sought-after, as it gives a 10% higher yield than its straightforward counterpart.

Bistot is a very valuable ore as it holds large portions of Zydrine and Pyerite. It also contains a decent amount of Mexallon.

Available primarily in null security status and wormhole systems.

items.name: Sharp Crokite
items.description:
In certain belts, environmental conditions will carve sharp, jagged edges into crokite rocks, resulting in the formation of sharp crokite. The increased density of these formations leads to a 5% greater mineral yield than standard crokite.

Crokite is a very heavy ore that is always in high demand because it has the largest ratio of Nocxium and Mexallon for any ore in the known universe. Valuable deposits of Pyerite can also be found within this rare ore.

Available primarily in low security status star systems.

items.name: Crystalline Crokite
items.description:
Crystalline crokite is the stuff of legend. Not only does it give a 10% greater yield than regular crokite, but chunks of the rock glitter beautifully in just the right light, making crystalline crokite popular as raw material for jewelry.

Crokite is a very heavy ore that is always in high demand because it has the largest ratio of Nocxium and Mexallon for any ore in the known universe. Valuable deposits of Pyerite can also be found within this rare ore.

Available primarily in low security status star systems.

items.name: Onyx Ochre
items.description:
Shiny black nuggets of onyx ochre look very nice and are occasionally used in ornaments. But the 5% higher mineral yield is what miners are really after. Like in all else, good looks are only an added bonus. 

Considered a worthless ore for years, dark ochre was ignored by most miners until improved reprocessing techniques managed to extract the huge amount of Isogen and Mexallon inside it. Dark ochre also contains useful amounts of Nocxium.

Available primarily in low security status star systems.

items.name: Obsidian Ochre
items.description:
Obsidian ochre, the most valuable member of the dark ochre family, was only first discovered a decade ago. The sleek black surface of this ore managed to absorb scanning waves, making obsidian ochre asteroids almost invisible. Advances in scanning technology revealed these beauties at last. This ore's 10% higher mineral yield makes it more than worth the effort required to find it.

Considered a worthless ore for years, dark ochre was ignored by most miners until improved reprocessing techniques managed to extract the huge amount of Isogen and Mexallon inside it. Dark ochre also contains useful amounts of Nocxium.

Available primarily in low security status star systems.

items.name: Vitric Hedbergite
items.description:
When asteroids containing hedbergite pass close to suns or other sources of intense heat can cause the hedbergite to glassify. The result is called vitric hedbergite and has 5% better yield than normal hedbergite. 

Hedbergite is sought after for its high concentration of Pyerite and Nocxium.

Available primarily in low security status star systems.

items.name: Glazed Hedbergite
items.description:
Asteroids containing this shiny ore were formed in intense heat, such as might result from a supernova. The result, known as glazed hedbergite, is a more concentrated form of hedbergite that has 10% higher yield.

Hedbergite is sought after for its high concentration of Pyerite and Nocxium.

Available primarily in low security status star systems.

items.name: Vivid Hemorphite
items.description:
Hemorphite exists in many different color variations. Interestingly, the more colorful it becomes, the better yield it has. Vivid hemorphite has 5% better yield than its more bland brother.

With a large portion of Nocxium, hemorphite is always a good find. It is common enough that even novice miners can expect to run into it. Hemorphite also has some amount of Isogen.

Available primarily in low security status star systems.

items.name: Radiant Hemorphite
items.description:
Hemorphite exists in many different color variations. Interestingly, the more colorful it becomes, the better yield it has. Radiant hemorphite has 10% better yield than its more bland brother.

With a large portion of Nocxium, hemorphite is always a good find. It is common enough that even novice miners can expect to run into it. Hemorphite also has some amount of Isogen.

Available primarily in low security status star systems.

items.name: Pure Jaspet
items.description:
Pure Jaspet is popular amongst corporate miners who are looking for various minerals for manufacturing, rather than mining purely for profit. Pure Jaspet contains fewer waste compounds than most asteroids, allows for approximately 5% better mineral yield from the same volume of ore.

Jaspet has two valuable mineral types, making it easy to sell. It has a large portion of Mexallon plus some Nocxium.

Available primarily in low security status star systems.

items.name: Pristine Jaspet
items.description:
Pristine Jaspet is very rare, which is not so surprising when one considers that it is formed when asteroids collide with comets or ice moons. It has 10% better yield than normal Jaspet.

Jaspet has two valuable mineral types, making it easy to sell. It has a large portion of Mexallon plus some Nocxium.

Available primarily in low security status star systems.

items.name: Luminous Kernite
items.description:
Prophets tell of the mystical nature endowed in luminous kernite. To the rest of us, it's an average looking ore that has 5% more yield than normal kernite and can make you rich if you mine it 24/7 and live to be very old.

Kernite is a fairly common ore type that yields fair amounts of Mexallon and Isogen.

Available primarly in low and null security status and wormhole systems.

items.name: Fiery Kernite
items.description:
Known as Rage Stone to veteran miners after a discovery of a particularly rich vein of it caused a bar brawl of epic proportions in the Intaki Syndicate. It has a 10% higher yield than basic kernite.

Kernite is a fairly common ore type that yields fair amounts of Mexallon and Isogen.

Available primarly in low and null security status and wormhole systems.

items.name: Azure Plagioclase
items.description:
Azure plagioclase is an uncommon variant of plagioclase that enjoys a 5% improved mineral yield. It was made infamous in the melancholic song prose Miner Blues by the Gallentean folk singer Jaroud Dertier three decades ago.

Plagioclase is not amongst the most valuable ore types around, but it contains a large amount of Tritanium and is thus always in constant demand. It also yields some Mexallon.

Available primarily in high security status star systems.

items.name: Rich Plagioclase
items.description:
With rich plagioclase, having 10% better yield than the normal one, miners can finally regard plagioclase as a mineral that provides a noteworthy profit.

Plagioclase is not amongst the most valuable ore types around, but it contains a large amount of Tritanium and is thus always in constant demand. It also yields some Mexallon.

Available primarily in high security status star systems.

items.name: Solid Pyroxeres
items.description:
Solid Pyroxeres, sometimes called the Flame of Dam'Torsad, is a relative of normal Pyroxeres. The Flame has 5% higher yield than its more common cousin. 

Pyroxeres is a common ore available in all regions of space. It has fair amounts of Pyerite and Mexallon.

Available in all known space and wormhole systems.

items.name: Viscous Pyroxeres
items.description:
Viscous Pyroxeres is the secret behind the success of ORE in the early days. ORE has since then moved into more profitable minerals, but Viscous Pyroxeres and its 10% higher mineral yield still holds a special place in the hearts of all miners dreaming of becoming the next mining moguls of EVE.

Pyroxeres is a common ore available in all regions of space. It has fair amounts of Pyerite and Mexallon.

Available in all known space and wormhole systems.

items.name: Condensed Scordite
items.description:
Condensed Scordite is a close cousin of normal Scordite, but with 5% better yield. The increase may seem insignificant, but matters greatly to new miners where every LUX counts.

Scordite is amongst the most common ore types in the central regions of known universe. It has a fair bit of Tritanium and Pyerite. Good choice for those starting their mining careers.

Available primarily in high security status star systems.

items.name: Massive Scordite
items.description:
Massive Scordite was the stuff of legend in the early days of space exploration, due to a 10% higher mineral yield than standard scordite. Though it has long since been taken over in value by other ores it still has a special place in the hearts of veteran miners.

Scordite is amongst the most common ore types in the central regions of known universe. It has a fair bit of Tritanium and Pyerite. Good choice for those starting their mining careers.

Available primarily in high security status star systems.

items.name: Bright Spodumain
items.description:
Spodumain is occasionally found with crystalline traces in its outer surface. Known as bright spodumain, the crystal adds approximately 5% more value to an already valuable mineral.

Spodumain is amongst the most desirable ore types around, as it contains high volumes of the most heavily demanded resource and some amounts of the more precious minerals. Huge volumes of Tritanium and moderate amounts of Isogen, Nocxium, Zydrine and Megacyte can be obtained by refining these rocks.

items.name: Gleaming Spodumain
items.description:
Once in a while Spodumain is found with crystalline veins running through it. The 10% increased value this yields puts a gleam in the eye of any miner lucky enough to find it.

Spodumain is amongst the most desirable ore types around, as it contains high volumes of the most heavily demanded resource and some amounts of the more precious minerals. Huge volumes of Tritanium and moderate amounts of Isogen, Nocxium, Zydrine and Megacyte can be obtained by refining these rocks.

items.name: Concentrated Veldspar
items.description:
Clusters of veldspar with 5% higher yield, called concentrated veldspar, are sometimes found in areas where normal veldspar is already in abundance.

Veldspar is the most common ore type in the central regions of known universe. It is still in constant demand as it holds a large portion of the much-used Tritanium mineral.

Available primarily in high security status star systems.

items.name: Dense Veldspar
items.description:
In asteroids above average size, the intense pressure can weld normal veldspar into what is known as dense veldspar, increasing the yield by 10%. 

Veldspar is the most common ore type in the central regions of known universe. It is still in constant demand as it holds a large portion of the much-used Tritanium mineral.

Available primarily in high security status star systems.

items.name: Radioactive Waste
items.description: This radioactively contaminated material is normally recycled or processed into fuel. It can be highly dangerous to any lifeforms that come into contact with it.

items.name: Inner Sanctum
items.description: This structure houses the senior members of the Zatah corpus blood raider sect.

items.name: Thorak's Biodome Garden
items.description: This biodome is used for cultivation of plants and animals alike. Minmatar corporations have contracted the operation to the Angel Cartel and there is a healthy profit to be made from the luxury foods manufactured here. The prime buyers are the newly rich.

items.name: Corpus Crimson Commander
items.description: Commands and directions emanate from this vessel as if the person at the helm owns the place. Perhaps he does...

items.name: Mul-Zatah Gatekeeper
items.description: DED's scout report database has this vessel simply listed as "The Top Dog".

items.name: QA Speed Limiter Module
items.description: This module does not exist.

items.name: Corporate Hangar Array
items.description: A large hangar structure with divisional compartments, for easy separation and storage of materials and modules.

items.name: Jenmai Hirokan
items.description: This is the infamous Angel Cartel pilot Jenmai.  Born a Caldari citizen, Jenmai was quickly taken and raised by the Guristas after his birth.  Many years later, after learning about his true past, he defected to the Angel Cartel, serving them quite well for the past decade.  Few can claim to rival Jenmais skills as a fighter pilot.

items.name: Jenmei's Tag
items.description: Jenmei's Tag.

items.name: Elena Gazky's DNA
items.description:
DNA samples are any of various nucleic acids that are usually the molecular basis of heredity, are localized especially in cell nuclei, and are constructed of a double helix held together by hydrogen bonds between purine and pyrimidine bases which project inward from two chains containing alternate links of deoxyribose and phosphate.

This is a DNA sample taken from a member of the infamous pirate gang 'The Seven'.

items.name: Imai Kenon
items.description: This is a fighter for the Guristas. It is protecting the assets of Guristas and may attack anyone it perceives as a threat or easy pickings. Threat level: Very high

items.name: Stationary Bestower
items.description: This Bestower-class industrial is currently undergoing maintenance.

items.description: These habitats house offices and processing utilities for the asteroid mining facility.

items.name: CreoCorp Main Factory
items.description: This is where small parts are built to be used in all kinds of spaceships further down the production line.

items.name: UNUSED_HabMod_Residential_LCS
items.description: This is a luxury version of the CreoDron Habitation Module for miners and deep space explorers. It is packed with hard working prospectors.

items.name: Sentinel Bloodraider
items.description: This Blood Raider Station has been refitted with huge XL torpedo batteries and a long range stasis web generators

items.name: Arch Angel Raelek
items.description: This is the Commander of the top Angel Cartel outpost in the Caldari State territories.  He virtually controls all Cartel activities inside the State. Threat level: Deadly

items.name: Raelek's Tag
items.description: This diamond tag carries the rank insignia equivalent of a captain within the Angel Cartel pirate organization. It may prove valuable if turned in at proper authorities.

items.name: Caldari AZ-1 Nexus Chip
items.description:
This small data chip stores the key elements of a ship's artificial intelligence system, and is used primarily for controlling the vessel's autonomous functions. This particular chip has been modified by top Kaalakiota scientists for the Caldari Navy, made to be of better quality than what is available on the open market. 

The AZ-1 chip is designed for battleship class vessels.

items.name: Asteroid Deadspace Mining Post
items.description: Where geographical conditions allow, outposts such as this one are a good way of increasing the effectiveness of deep-space mining operations.

items.name: Deadspace Control Station
items.description: Bases such as this one are commonly used as on-site mining posts or colonies. They are often obscurely located and vulnerable as well and therefore it is common that pirates make their homes in them, sometimes with the resident's full consent. This one looks unusually exposed and vulnerable due to what appear to be major renovations.

items.name: Caldari CU-1 Nexus Chip
items.description:
This small data chip stores the key elements of a ship's artificial intelligence system, and is used primarily for controlling the vessel's autonomous functions. This particular chip has been modified by top Kaalakiota scientists for the Caldari Navy, made to be of better quality than what is available on the open market. 
  
The CU-1 chip is designed for cruiser class vessels.

items.name: Caldari BY-1 Nexus Chip
items.description:
This small data chip stores the key elements of a ship's artificial intelligence system, and is used primarily for controlling the vessel's autonomous functions. This particular chip has been modified by top Kaalakiota scientists for the Caldari Navy, made to be of better quality than what is available on the open market. 
 
The BY-1 chip is designed for frigate class vessels.

items.name: Tracking Array
items.description: Boosts turret sentries' optimal range and tracking speed.

items.name: Uleen Bloodsworn
items.description: This is a fighter for the Blood Raiders. She is protecting the assets of the Blood Raiders and may attack anyone she perceives as a threat or easy pickings. Threat level: Very high

items.name: Uleen Bloodsworn's Tag
items.description: This gold tag carries the rank insignia equivalent of a sergeant within the Blood Raider pirate cult. It may prove valuable if turned in at proper authorities.

items.name: Purple Particle Research Patrol
items.description: This deadly adversary houses the control bridge for the particle accelerator. Its defenses are considerable.

items.name: General Hixous Puxley
items.description: Your sensors indicate that this battleship is the source of a lot of coded transmissions.

items.name: Supply Headman
items.description: This ship looks like a standard Domination Seraphim vessel except this one is fitted with at least double the amount of what you normally see of missile turrets.

items.name: Docked & Loaded Mammoth
items.description: This Mammoth class industrial seems to be undergoing maintainance, but your sensors indicate that for some purpose, it is protected behind an extremely powerful shield...

items.name: Megathron under frantic repair
items.description: There is a lot of activity around this partially constructed Megathron. As you start to wonder why, you notice that your sensors indicate it is protected by an extremely durable shield.

items.name: The Antimatter Channeler
items.description: If you ever saw a silent and unpredictable presence, this would be it.

items.name: Activists
items.description: People engaged in anti-establishment activity of some sort, most often political or economical in nature.

items.name: Pro-Trade Pamphlets
items.description: Propaganda prose by supporters of Eman Autrech, singing the praise of free trade and universal love.

items.name: Virgin Forest Pulp
items.description: Tree pulp used to produce paper.

items.name: Bronze Sculpture
items.description: Bronze Sculpture of president Souro Foiritan.

items.name: Silver Sculpture
items.description: Silver Sculpture of president Souro Foiritan.

items.name: Gold Sculpture
items.description: Gold sculpture of president Souro Foiritan.

items.name: Powerful EM Forcefield
items.description: A reinforced antimatter generator powered by muonal crystals, creating a perfect circle of electro-magnetic radiance.

items.name: Ultra Fast Silo
items.description: Used to store or provide resources.

items.name: Exotic Dancers, Female
items.description: Exotic dancing is considered an art form, even though not everyone might agree. Exposing the flesh in public places may be perfectly acceptable within the Federation, but in the Amarr Empire it's considered a grave sin and a sign of serious deviancy.

items.name: Kameiras
items.description: An elite type of foot soldier, originally bred from Minmatar slaves by the Amarr Empire. Raised from birth to become soldiers, they serve the Empire, Khanid Kingdom and Ammatar well, although always kept on a tight leash.

items.name: Fluxed Condensates
items.description: When combined with other materials and alloys, fluxed condensates help contribute to a unique quantum state highly conducive to efficient reactor operation.

items.name: Large AutoCannon Battery
items.description: Fires a barrage of extra large projectiles at those the Control Tower deems its enemies. Maintains a consistent spread of fire and is able to track the faster-moving targets, but lacks the sheer bludgeoning force of its artillery counterpart.

items.name: Medium AutoCannon Battery
items.description: Fires a barrage of large projectiles at those the Control Tower deems its enemies. Maintains a consistent spread of fire and is able to track fast-moving targets, but lacks some of the power of its artillery counterpart.

items.name: Small AutoCannon Battery
items.description: Fires a barrage of medium projectiles at those the Control Tower deems its enemies. Maintains a very rapid spread of fire and is able to track the fastest targets at close ranges, but lacks some of the punch evidenced by its artillery counterpart.

items.name: XL Torpedo Battery
items.description: A torpedo launcher capable of firing the most powerful type of torpedo ever invented. A volley of these deathbringers can make piecemeal of most anything that floats in space.

items.name: Starbase Major Assembly Array
items.description: Assembly Arrays are oftentimes required to manufacture many high-tech and illegal modules that the empires don't want manufactured in their stations.  This is one of the biggest of its kind, able to churn out a great deal of equipment in relatively short order.

items.name: Starbase Minor Assembly Array
items.description: Assembly Arrays are oftentimes required to manufacture many high-tech and illegal modules that the empires don't want manufactured in their stations.  While humble in size, this one is able to operate at a high level of efficiency, bringing its operators quality modules with surprising speed.

items.name: Amarr Starbase Control Tower
items.description: The Amarr have always been fond of majestic and intimidating constructions. Their Control Towers do not deviate from that tradition and are truly big and powerful structures, intended more for preservation of territorial interests than commercial benefits.

items.name: Caldari Starbase Control Tower
items.description: At first the Caldari Control Towers were manufactured by Kaalakiota, but since they focused their efforts mostly on other, more profitable installations, they soon lost the contract and the Ishukone corporation took over the Control Towers' development and production.

items.name: Gallente Starbase Control Tower
items.description: Gallente Control Towers are more pleasing to the eye than they are strong or powerful. They have above average electronic countermeasures, average CPU output, and decent power output compared to towers from the other races, but are quite lacking in sophisticated defenses.

items.name: Minmatar Starbase Control Tower
items.description:
The Matari aren't really that high-tech, preferring speed rather than firepower or involved technology. Unfortunately that doesn't apply very well to stationary objects, much to the liking of the Amarr Empire.

Amarrians call it a scrapheap of epic proportions. But don't underestimate these structures. Minmatar commanders usually have the last laugh when it comes to combat.

items.name: Starbase Hangar
items.description: A stand-alone deep-space construction designed to allow pilots to dock and refit their ships on the fly.

items.name: Starbase Ion Field Projection Battery
items.description: Projects a low intensity field of ionized particles to disrupt the effectivenes of enemy sensors. Very effective against Magnetometric-based sensors.

items.name: Starbase Force Field Array
items.description: This array projects a password-protected force field around structures outside the range of a control tower's shields.

items.name: Starbase Auxiliary Power Array
items.description: These arrays provide considerable added power output, allowing for an increased number of deployable structures in the starbase's field of operation.

items.name: Starbase Reactor Array
items.description: Moon Harvesting Arrays yield a number of moon materials that are then fed to Reactors. Reactors then process the materials in order to produce intermediate or final materials for use in keeping the Starbase's structures on-line and functioning.

items.name: Starbase Shield Generator
items.description: Smaller confined shield generators with their own access restrictions can be deployed outside the Control Tower's defense perimeter. This allows for lesser security areas around the Starbase, for purposes of storage or pickup.

items.name: Starbase Storage Facility
items.description: Storage silos are much more secure and durable than their Secure Container counterparts. They are usually the focus of attacks on outposts and commonly contain ore, reprocessed minerals or valuable items waiting to be transported to empire space.

items.name: Starbase Moon Harvester
items.description: A harvesting factory for collecting moon minerals.

items.name: Starbase Medium Refinery
items.description: The refinery is the heart of any industrial outpost, increasing the efficiency of any mining operation through reduced travel time. They are less efficient than full fledged stations, but the benefits of not having to move unrefined ore outweighs this drawback considerably.

items.name: Starbase Minor Refinery
items.description: A factory that refines ore into minerals.

items.name: Freedom Fighters
items.description:
Freedom Fighters have dedicated their life to freeing those who have been enslaved by the Amarr Empire, Khanid Kingdom or various pirate factions. Their purpose is to bring freedom and equality to the population of the galaxy.

But although their ultimate goal may be noble, their methods are often not approved by the Minmatar authorities, nor their allies the Gallente Federation. Their opponents call them terrorists, and they have been banned from the Caldari State due to the State's historical relationship with the Khanid Kingdom.

items.name: Amarr TIL-1 Nexus Chip
items.description:
This small data chip stores the key elements of a ship's artificial intelligence system, and is used primarily for controlling the vessel's autonomous functions. This particular chip has been modified by top Viziam scientists for the Imperial Navy, made to be of better quality than what is available on the open market. 

The TIL-1 chip is designed for battleship class vessels.

items.name: Elite Slaves
items.description: Slavery has always been a questionable industry, favored by the Amarr Empire and detested by the Gallente Federation. These elite slaves are exceptionally well suited for physical labor.

items.name: Dented Cask
items.description: This reinforced container is outfitted with a capturing mechanism to pick up data from nearby sensor arrays. The cargo ship carrying this to its destination seems to have met some kind of disasterous end.

items.name: Non-Secured Asteroid Colony
items.description: Carving out asteroids to act as habitats for miners and manufacturers is a cheap and efficient way to quickly cash in on the insatiable needs of the space industry. The construction of this one is underway and the defenses are weak.

items.name: Retired Mining Veteran
items.description: The communication sensors on your ship are going haywire. Judging from the signals and coding being transmitted from this vessel, it could just be the big cahuna in this deadspace pocket. Who knows?

items.name: Genom Tara's Insignia
items.description:
Identification tags such as these may prove valuable if handed to the proper organization.  

Genom Tara is a legendary Ammatar commander who bears deep hatred of the Minmatar Republic.  He is most notable for refusing to obey direct orders from the Ammatar government to withdraw from his position in the Minmatar - Ammatar border.

items.name: Serpentis Supply Stronghold
items.description: This gigantic station is one of the Serpentis military installations and a black jewel of the alliance between The Guardian Angels and The Serpentis Corporation. Even for it's size it has no commercial station services or docking bay to receive guests.

items.name: Staff Quarters
items.description: The architectural design for the CreoDron Habitation Module started out as a contract deal from the Expert Housing Corporation to standardize the modular drifter homes normally used by miners and deep space explorers. When the project was cancelled due to insufficient funding, CreoDron utilized their design for the open market as high-orbit department buildings for commercial use. The marketing was a tremendous hit, making the Habitation Module a common sight across the universe. Common uses include anything from bars, casinos and brothels, to police stations and interrogation facilities.

While their individual setup might differ in terms of ship size they can transport and whether they require a certain passkey or code to be used, all share the same fundamental function of hurling space vessels to a destination beacon within solar system boundaries.

items.name: Iridescent Gneiss
items.description:
Gneiss is often the first major league ore that up and coming miners graduate to. Finding the more expensive variation of Gneiss, called Iridescent Gneiss, is a major coup for these miners due to its 5% greater mineral yield.

Gneiss is a popular ore type because it holds significant volumes of three heavily used minerals, increasing its utility value. It has quite a bit of Mexallon as well as some Pyerite and Isogen.

Available primarily in low security status and wormhole systems.

items.name: Prismatic Gneiss
items.description:
Prismatic Gneiss has a fracturized molecule-structure, which explains its unique appearance. It is the most sought after member of the Gneiss family, as it yields 10% more than common Gneiss.

Gneiss is a popular ore type because it holds significant volumes of three heavily used minerals, increasing its utility value. It has quite a bit of Mexallon as well as some Pyerite and Isogen.

Available primarily in low security status and wormhole systems.

items.name: Silvery Omber
items.description:
Silvery Omber was first discovered some fifty years ago in an asteroid belt close to a large moon. The luminescence from the moon made this uncommon cousin of normal Omber seem silvery in appearance, hence the name. It is still considered a lucky find by miners across New Eden due to a roughly 5% improved mineral yield compared to standard omber.

Omber is a common ore that is still an excellent ore for novice miners as it has a sizeable portion of Isogen, as well as some Pyerite. A few trips of mining this and a novice is quick to rise in status.

Available primarily in low security status and wormhole systems.

items.name: Golden Omber
items.description:
Golden Omber spurred one of the largest gold rushes in the early days of space faring, when isogen was the king of minerals. The 10% extra yield it offers over common Omber was all it took to make it the most sought after ore for a few years.

Omber is a common ore that is still an excellent ore for novice miners as it has a sizeable portion of Isogen, as well as some Pyerite. A few trips of mining this and a novice is quick to rise in status.

Available primarily in low security status and wormhole systems.

items.name: Magma Mercoxit
items.description:
Though it floats through the frigid depths of space, magma mercoxit's striking appearance and sheen gives it the impression of bubbling magma. If this visual treasure wasn't enticing enough, the 5% higher yield certainly attracts admirers.

Mercoxit is a very dense ore that must be mined using specialized deep core mining techniques. It contains massive amounts of the extraordinary Morphite mineral.

Available primarly in null security status star systems.

items.name: Vitreous Mercoxit
items.description:
Vitreous mercoxit gleams in the dark, like a siren of myth. Found only in rare clusters in space vitreous mercoxit is very rare, but very valuable, due to its much higher 10% yield.

Mercoxit is a very dense ore that must be mined using specialized deep core mining techniques. It contains massive amounts of the extraordinary Morphite mineral.

Available primarly in null security status star systems.

3% reduced capacitor need for remote armor repair system modules.

items.description: Tools used in various construction projects, such as ship, module or ground vehicle manufacturing. High-Tech tools are of better quality than the more common prototypes, and are more expensive.

items.name: High-Tech Small Arms
items.description:

They are implemented with a safety net which prevents them from being used illegally in stations where most types of small arms are prohibited. Therefore many regions do not apply the small arms ban on these weapons.

items.name: High-Tech Transmitters
items.description: An electronic device that generates and amplifies a carrier wave, modulates it with a meaningful signal derived from speech or other sources, and radiates the resulting signal from an antenna. The High-Tech prototype is almost immune to any type of de-scrambling devices, making the transmission more secure.

items.name: Thick Blue Ice
items.description:
Interstellar ices are formed by accretion of gas molecules onto silicate dust particles. Due to its unique chemical composition and the circumstances under which it forms, blue ice will, under normal circumstances, contain more oxygen isotopes than any other ice asteroid. This particular formation is an old one and therefore contains even more than its less mature siblings.

Available in 0.0 security status solar systems or lower.

items.name: Pristine White Glaze
items.description:
When star fusion processes occur near high concentrations of silicate dust, such as those found in interstellar ice fields, the substance known as White Glaze is formed. While White Glaze generally is extremely high in nitrogen-14 and other stable nitrogen isotopes, a few rare fragments, such as this one, have stayed free of radioactive contaminants and are thus richer in isotopes than their more impure counterparts.

Available in 0.0 security status solar systems or lower.

items.name: Smooth Glacial Mass
items.description:
Interstellar ices are formed by accretion of gas molecules onto silicate dust particles. Glacial masses are known to contain hydrogen isotopes in abundance, but the high surface diffusion on this particular mass means it has considerably more than its coarser counterparts.

Available in 0.0 security status solar systems or lower.

items.name: Enriched Clear Icicle
items.description:
Interstellar ices are formed by accretion of gas molecules onto silicate dust particles. These crystalline formations can be found scattered around many an ice field and are known as the universe's primary source of helium isotopes. Due to environmental factors, this fragment's isotope deposits have become even richer than its regular counterparts'.

Available in 0.0 security status solar systems or lower.

items.description: This security code is one half of what is needed to enter the Serpentis Fleet HQ. The gate will remain open for a short period of time after the code will be used. After usage, the gate security system automatically creates a new password, rendering this code useless.

items.name: Shipyard
items.description: Large construction tasks can be undertaken at this shipyard.

items.name: Dark Shipyard
items.description: This industrial structure serves as a platform for warehouses and the sorting of cargo containers.

items.name: Dirty Shipyard
items.description: This industrial structure serves as a platform for warehouses and the sorting of cargo containers.

items.name: Rogue Mercenary Thorn
items.description: Rogue Mercenaries always work for the highest bidder.  Their ships and equipment varies, as they use whatever is available at the time.  Threat level: Deadly

items.name: Seven Grunt
items.description: This is a fighter working for 'The Seven', a vast criminal network which operates from a host of secret pirate strongholds strewn across the known universe. Threat level: Moderate

items.name: Seven Death Dealer
items.description: This is a fighter working for 'The Seven', a vast criminal network which operates from a host of secret pirate strongholds strewn across the known universe. Threat level: High

items.name: Seven Deathguard
