Speed while active -50%
Shield recharge rate -99%
Capacitor recharge boost x3

This module is adapted for use only on frigates and other small ships.

items.name: Settler Intelligence Briefing
items.description:
Hostile rogue drones hunt and scavenge every system in this constellation we call Phoenix. They grow stronger as you move away from Angelice. They are reported more commonly near planets but sightings occur almost anywhere.

Large asteroid clusters have been cataloged in each system. In some, a large rogue drone structure appears to be devouring the raw ore and so the Settlers have begun calling the clusters 'Moon Eater'. Another location with dense resources has been found, but exploration attempts have failed due to an infested Abaddon who sits on watch. Ophidia Operations, based in Serpentis, are working on a technology to provide concealment.

Your starter pack contains a blueprint we believe will provide access to the system Askur, which is currently locked by sophisticated encryption. We don't know what Askur has in store.

Settler security forces have not yet been established, guard yourself. However, should your ship be destroyed, starter packs can be purchased from the market here in Angelice.

items.name: Crude Extractor
items.description: Module used in the extraction of crude matter required for all types of fuel by drawing exotic material through a crude rift.

items.name: Placeholder Crude Crystal
items.description: Placeholder description for Crude Crystal.

items.name: EE-S “Synopsis“ G-0
items.description: An elite offering from Sunmahani Corporation, specialists in crude technologies, the Synopsis G-0 engine showcases exceptional fuel efficiency and rapid capacitor recovery. This premium model signifies the pinnacle of performance and elegance in eonic engine technology.

items.name: Eotane Broken.
items.description: This Crude-derived tetrahedral crystal-lattice fluid serves as the lifeblood of the Frontier’s capsuleers, powering the engine of almost every quality vessel in the heavens.

items.name: Lens 60X
items.description: For use with Crude Extractors only.

items.name: Sophrogon
items.description: The light fraction refined from crude: rich in energy and quick to vaporise.

items.name: Crude - Old/Rough
items.description:
Braids of serenity and power entwine and disperse across the surface. Within, they dance as if begging to be set free. From this rhythm, the dreams of those long passed and those newly awoken may spring forth.

A quiet fragility eminates from the matter’s movements, the ethereal beauty of transience. Practicality has no need of such things.

items.name: Ancient Anomaly
items.description: The Ancient Anomaly is a known deposit of Old Crude Matter. This substance is vital for long-term operations, providing a consistent energy output for warp drives. The extraction process, while complex, is a necessary task for the continued exploration and understanding of the Molok galaxy.

items.name: Embark
items.description: Extra small hydrogen engine. Runs exclusively on hydrogen fuel.

items.name: FEC Shrapnel S
items.description: Fixed Explosive Charge for light cannons

items.name: Maitreyi MLRS
items.description: This tiny Multiple Launch Rocket System, named for its designer, can carry a very limited supply of rockets. It uses small missiles that can either carry an explosive warhead to inflict maximum damage, or an EMP to neutralize the target's capacitor reserve.

items.name: MLRS charge: Antimaterial (Unused)
items.description: A small rocket unit with an explosive warhead designed to effectively destroy enemy armor and hull.

items.name: MLRS Charge: EMP (Unused)
items.description: A small rocket unit with an EMP warhead designed to neutralize enemy capacitor and shields.

items.name: Epoch InfraLaser
items.description: This pulse laser fires infrared light beams which transmit electromagnetic radiation and melt the target with thermal damage. The Epoch uses two separate laser focusing systems to reduce the cooldown period between shots. It's optimized for medium ranges and consumes less power as other models as it breaks shields, but it's poorly suited for attacks against armor.

items.name: Megaannum InfraLaser
items.description: This pulse laser fires infrared light beams which transmit electromagnetic radiation and melt the target with thermal damage. The Megaannum uses an amplified laser focusing system to maximize its range and accuracy. It's optimized for longer ranges and breaks shields efficiently, but it's poorly suited for attacks against armor.

items.name: Eon InfraLaser
items.description:
The Eon is the ultimate pulse laser of the Frontier, firing infrared light beams which transmit electromagnetic radiation and melt the target with thermal damage. It uses four light laser focusing systems for excellent damage and range. Considering its enormous damage, it can be used to eliminate the armor of light targets, though it's better at efficiently obliterating shields and finishing off prey.

Large mass that affects ship's maneuverability.

items.name: Infrared CPS
items.description: This processing system containing a light-focusing crystal modulates the beam of a laser weapon into appropriate infrared frequencies to power high-thermal-damage attacks.

items.name: Dynamic Armor S (Unused)
items.description:
This module is designed to destroy missiles on approach to the ship. It uses the capacitor to transmit a powerful electromagnetic pulse which spreads around the ship, capable of detonating small missiles and bombs and causing minor damage to nearby ships.

This iteration is adapted for use only on frigates and other small ships.

items.name: Shield Recharge Redistributor
items.description: This device redistributes capacitor and engine power to significantly speed up the recharge of the shield. Since it uses the ship's engine as an energy transmitter, it reduces the maximum speed of the ship for the duration of activation but doesn't block the use of propulsion modules.

items.name: DEV
items.description: Destroy... Destroy... Destroy...

items.name: Cotemporal Armor Restorer S
items.description: This module uses liquid alloy patches to restore armor quickly during combat. The repair fluid, guided by electromagnetic manipulators, cools and solidifies at the completion of emplacement cycle. This method uses the repair material more efficiently and restores more at a time but has a longer emplacement cycle. Only one Cotemporal Armor Restorer can be fitted on a ship.

items.name: Armor Patch
items.description: This dense liquid armor patch can be installed on the ship's hull with the armor restorer's electromagnetic manipulator. When the electromagnetic trap stops working, the liquid quickly hardens to become strong and heat resistant. The basis of the liquid composition is aestacium--the mineral's layered micro-structure provides the armor with a fast heat sink.

items.name: Shield Micro-Generator S
items.description: This fitting increases the maximum strength of the shield at the expense of capacitor storage. It draws constant power from the capacitor energy reserves to generate shielding.

items.name: Capacitor-ERU S
items.description: This capacitor energy redistribution unit increases capacitor maximums at the expense of maximum velocity, redirecting power from the engines to the capacitor unit.

items.name: CPU Frequency Amplifier S
items.description: This amplifier used to increase CPU output.

items.name: Fuel Catalyst
items.description:
The Fuel Catalyst is an essential component for synthesizing fuel from Crude Matter, a metasubstance that enables warp jumps and contains a largely unexplored energetic potential. This catalyst is vital for the production of both SOF-type and EU-type fuels. It can be extracted from enemies or manufactured at specific stations.

This technology, widely mastered by feral drones, remains beyond the reach of many station-based fabricators due to their limited power capabilities. The Fuel Catalyst can frequently be found among logistical drones, but it’s much rarer among the industries of lost colonies. Its critical role in transforming the enigmatic Crude Matter into usable fuel places it at the heart of space exploration and warfare.

items.name: Crustal Anorthosite Crystals
items.description:
Calcium-sodium aluminosilicate feldspar crystals from basaltic crust of differentiated asteroids.

Makes up most of Rind, Glaze and Marrow asteroids. Bone, Flint and Spall asteroids also carry it beneath their crust.

items.name: Nickel-Iron Veins
items.description:
Nickel-bearing alloys commonly intermixed with iron in metallic asteroids. 

Nickel-Iron Veins is commonly refined from Iron-Rich Nodules

items.name: Silicon Dust
items.description:
Abundant non-metal hosted in silicate minerals throughout asteroids. 

Silicon Dust is commonly refined from Silica Grains.

items.name: Tholin Aggregates
items.description:
Prebiotic tar-like organics produced by long-term radiation chemistry. 

Tholin Aggregates is commonly refined from Hydrocarbon Residue.

items.name: Platinum-Group Veins
items.description:
Rare platinum-group metals concentrated in differentiated asteroid cores. 

Platinum-Group Veins is commonly refined from Iron-Rich Nodules.

items.name: Massive Ataxite Matrix
items.description:
Platinum and palladium concentrated in nickel-rich metallic grains from intermediate core zones. Forms during slow cooling of differentiated asteroid cores.

Found deep in the metallic cores of Ingot and Spar asteroids. Flint and Spall asteroids hold smaller amounts beneath their crust.

items.name: Hydrated Gossan Matrix
items.description:
Water-bearing sulfide-rich material common in carbonaceous chondrites. Represents aqueous alteration of metal sulfides in the early solar system.

Rich deposits lie beneath the crust of Murk asteroids. Grist, Scale and Spar asteroids carry smaller amounts, and traces sit deep in the cores of Mire asteroids.

items.name: Natural Asteroid Field
items.description: A common sight in many star systems, the Natural Asteroid Field is a vast array of asteroids and celestial debris. Featuring a rich variety of asteroids—from metal-rich types laden with iron-nickel and precious metals, to carbonaceous variants teeming with organic compounds and silicates—this field is a crucial resource hub. Its diversity offers an abundant supply of materials for those ready to undertake the task of resource extraction. Thus, the Natural Asteroid Field represents an essential destination for miners and explorers in their quest for valuable resources.

items.name: Unstable Fuel
items.description: Long abandoned and left to the mercy of the Static Shear, little energy or even structure remains. This lingering dross provides barely enough of a spark to power a vessel. Even the best refinery processes cannot prevent the decay of time from claiming their product.

items.name: Jovian Symbolic Navigator 2:5:7:26:8
items.description:
Extracted from the decaying ruins of an ancient Jove installation, this trinary data structure is prominently tagged with a specific Jovian symbol or pictogram. Whatever the significance of the particular pictogram associated with this data, the inner complexities of the structure are actually a specific navigation algorithm designed to work with warp drives.

When integrated with ship's navigation systems and activated, this algorithm warps the vessel to a location that is relative to the position in space of the ship at the time of activation. The data structure essentially encodes a precise, though in isolation arbitrary, point-to-point warp vector using the inertial frame of reference known to be used by Jove navigation systems, which can be interpreted and acted on by any modern ship's warp drive computers.

This data can be used to initiate a single warp journey from any chosen origin point within a star system, although with the restriction that the algorithm appears to inherently constrain activation to within a certain distance from a central stellar gravity well. Presumably, if a given origin point is known the data will lead to a specific location. It could be that these locations are navigational waypoints within a star system, with a chain of such leading to some ultimate destination.

items.name: EE-S “Advanced Operations“ G-1
items.description: The Advanced Operations G-1 is an advanced eonic engine leveraging pure Eotane. Offering substantial capacitor recovery, it's particularly suitable for smaller vessels, enhancing their operational efficiency and warp capabilities.

items.name: Cutting Laser
items.description: A direct energy tool useful for breaking apart solid matter. Like many of its forebearers, it can serve needs beyond its intended purpose. Adaptation is necessary for survival.

items.name: SOF-77 Test Fuel
items.description:
SOF-77 is a high-energy fuel variant for SOF-type engines, ideal for operations requiring intense energy output. 

This Sophrogon-derived tetrahedral crystal-lattice fluid, it provides a surge of power that can drive even the most demanding systems, making it a go-to choice for high-stakes, energy-intensive operations.

items.name: Heavy Storage
items.description: A programmable storage unit.

items.name: Feral Drone Infestation
items.description: It's a beacon left by Consortium research drones, according to the signature this unit is chasing a hive of wild drones or something similar.

items.name: Feral Drone Scout
items.description: Rogue drones are hi-tech drones that have the ability to manufacture themselves. Rogue drone hives can be found throughout the universe of EVE and are a constant menace to space travelers. Threat level: Moderate  ( copy )

items.name: Feral Hive Outrider
items.description: Rogue drones are hi-tech drones that have the ability to manufacture themselves. Rogue drone hives can be found throughout the universe of EVE and are a constant menace to space travelers. Threat level: Moderate  ( copy )

items.name: Infested Station

items.name: Water Ice
items.description:
Essential volatile preserved in cold outer-belt environments.

Hydrated Gossan Matrix and Primitive Rime Shards are common sources of Water Ice.

items.name: Native Reef Nodules
items.description:
Dense iridium-osmium-ruthenium alloy nodules from the deepest, hottest core regions. Among the most refractory materials in the solar system.

Found in small amounts in the weathered surface of Ingot asteroids.

items.name: Crude - Young/Rough
items.description:
Currents of energy flicker almost playfully just beneath the surface. Deeper, the flows meld, forming a sea of emotion. The hue surrounding the matter changes with these internal tides, reflecting whichever passion dominates in the moment.

It is this mercurial nature which entices, which promises the ability to shape the future. So sweet is the call that danger, no matter how apparent, is easily ignored.

items.name: Eupraxite
items.description: The heavy fraction refined from crude: dense, rich in energy and slow to vaporise.

items.name: Primitive Rime Shards
items.description:
Pure methane ice preserved at cryogenic temperatures in outer asteroid belt regions.

Found frozen deep in the cores of Pitch asteroids, and beneath the crust of Mire and Char asteroids in smaller amounts.

items.name: Primordial Anthraxolite Sludge
items.description:
Unaltered complex organic polymer preserved from early solar system formation, less processed than C-type kerogen.

Common beneath the crust of Ember, Scale and Char asteroids, and present in most dark, carbon-rich bodies such as Mire and Pitch.

items.name: Irradiated Anthraxolite Veins
items.description:
Concentrated deposits of complex aromatic hydrocarbons formed through extended space weathering and radiation processing of organic ices.

Richest beneath the crust of Soot asteroids. Pitch asteroids also carry large veins, and Grist, Ember and Mire smaller ones.

items.name: Irradiated Cryoconite Nodules
items.description:
Prebiotic tar-like organics formed from radiation-driven chemistry.

Widespread beneath the crust of dark, carbon-rich asteroids, most of all Pitch, Char, Ember and Mire.

items.name: Natural Asteroid Cluster
items.description: Something ancient drew these rocks together and continues to hold them in each other’s embrace. They slowly circle their partners, creating a crude dance as they drift between stars. Through all the hostilities of the Frontier, some small moments of beauty remain.

items.name: Frostborn Ring
items.description: The Frostborn Ring, in contrast, is situated in the colder reaches of space. This asteroid ring is notable for its high concentration of osmium within its deep-core ores. Osmium, a dense and durable metal, is highly sought after for various industrial applications. The extreme cold of the region has preserved the osmium in a remarkably pure state, making the Frostborn Ring a prime location for mining this valuable resource.

items.name: Hermetite Harvester
items.description: The Hermetite Harvester stands as a solitary giant in the cold expanse of space. This Moon Eater-class facility, once bustling with human activity, now functions in solitude, its purpose to produce Hermetite, a synthetic, intelligent mineral. The Harvester irradiates raw materials, stimulating the embedded nanobots within the Hermetite, resulting in a material that can withstand significant loads and recover from damage. The Harvester continues its relentless task, a grim reminder of the human presence that once guided its operation.

items.description: A small pocket of the Frontier’s bounty rests within this folding fabric of space. A temptation for the youngest of the Frontier’s inhabitants. A faint echo of forces beyond understanding.

items.name: Swarm Frigate
items.description:
Swarm Frigate: Danger Assessment

The Swarm Frigate is distinguished by its lethal efficiency. As a compact and deadly unit of the AI fleet, it poses a significant risk, particularly in swarm tactics or as a vanguard for larger vessels. The Swarm Frigate's role in the AI's strategy is typically to destabilize defenses and create openings for more devastating attacks. Its presence is an indicator of the AI's aggressive, coordinated assault patterns, aimed at overwhelming human defenses through speed and precision.

items.name: Swarm Cruiser
items.description:
Swarm Cruiser: Danger Assessment

The Swarm Cruiser represents a grave threat due to its lethal design and purpose. As part of the feral AI swarm, its primary objective is the efficient and ruthless elimination of human targets. With its potent armaments and relentless AI-driven strategies, Swarm Cruiser is a symbol of the existential danger posed by these AI swarms. Its mere presence in a sector is a cause for significant concern, as it signifies the AI's focused intent on human destruction.

items.name: Swarm Battleship
items.description:
Swarm Battleship: Danger Assessment

The Swarm Battleship is a formidable embodiment of the feral AI swarm's destructive intent. Its sheer size and armament make it a catastrophic threat in any confrontation. As a tool of the AI's mission to eradicate human presence, Swarm Battleship's presence in any theater of operation signals a dire escalation. Its design and function are singularly focused on the annihilation of human fleets and strongholds, making it a paramount concern in our defensive strategy.

items.name: Hermetite Harvester ( copy )
items.description: The Hermetite Harvester stands as a solitary giant in the cold expanse of space. This Moon Eater-class facility, once bustling with human activity, now functions in solitude, its purpose to produce Hermetite, a synthetic, intelligent mineral. The Harvester irradiates raw materials, stimulating the embedded nanobots within the Hermetite, resulting in a material that can withstand significant loads and recover from damage. The Harvester continues its relentless task, a grim reminder of the human presence that once guided its operation. ( copy )

items.description: Promises of wealth and prosperity flow from this warping fabric of reality. The potential spoils contained within beg to be claimed, calling out for a grand undertaking. Those that heed this call may find themselves with company, compatriots or otherwise.

items.name: Rift 0759
items.description: Faint traces of other disturbances flow from this churning conflux of time and space. They vanish quickly into the horizon, unable to point the way. Here, at their nexus, lies the possibility of a great harvest, along with the shadow of the conflict such a bounty draws.

items.name: Rift 07CF
items.description: Through the folding of space comes the promise to not just survive but build anew, a thought otherwise impossible in the reality of the Frontier. The wealth leaking from these seams is finite, unlike the potential locked within. Considered application of ambition and hardware can create a flood of opportunity.

items.name: Keeper Note
items.description:
Welcome,

You are placed in a temporary clone body, provided by Keep free of charge. The Awakening Protocol has been activated, your mind has been transferred out of stasis.
The Neosphere of this star system is heavily damaged. You need to exit it to access more information.

The stargate is quarantined, but we can break through using the Bridgehead Key. Local industrial facilities will suffice, given materials.

You may be pleased to find that this is a Pilot Wave enabled body. A compatible vessel will be provided.

Awake, eternally.

items.name: Petraklao
items.description: The Static and Null Shears twist and rip away the stories held in neural pathways. Even those connected to the feral network are not immune. A single mind, biological or otherwise, however, is not the only container of memory. Some small fragments of the ancestors of this drone survive in the collective protocols governing its behavior. An occasional impulse, the surrender to pure instinct, all followed to their logical conclusions.

items.description: It's a beacon left by Consortium research drones, according to the signature this unit is chasing a hive of wild drones or something similar. ( copy )

items.name: Pulverized Asteroid Cluster
items.description: A cluster of planetoids, fragmented and broken. At range, it is impossible to tell if the Static Shear or something less cosmic in scale, but no less dangerous to an Awakened, is responsible for this formation. Regardless, the promise of minerals is difficult for any denizen of the Frontier to ignore. Great projects require great sacrifices to complete and the stars are littered with reminders of this lesson.

items.name: Accelerator Facility
items.description: The only remaining hardware connecting this facility to the outside world and the only way for the sins committed here to continue leaking out.

items.name: Ruined Processing Plant
items.description: A long dead monument to the promise of the Frontier to its former inhabitants. Such a structure is a reminder that the galaxy’s wealth extends to even the most mundane ore.

items.name: Abandoned Processing Plant
items.description: The equipment and protocols once relied upon to extract precious resources have lain dormant for millennia. A revelation about the process of feralization may lurk somewhere deep in these dead processors. More immediately, the fruits of its ancient work may yet prove a boon to the Frontier's new inhabitants.

items.name: Ruined Bombardment Cannon
items.description: The remains of an ancient weapon of mass destruction. Its exact workings are lost to time, as is whether or not it was ever fired.

items.name: Feralized Outpost
items.description: Once a secure logistics hub, feralization has added functionality its original creators could only dream of. For its new masters, however, it is beneath notice. Usually.

items.name: Reinforced Transport Container
items.description: Even seemingly empty, an echo remains, slithering around its interior. The reinforced construction and additional shielding imply its manufacturers had some idea of the nature of its contents.

items.name: Ore Storage Silo
items.description: Used for storing raw materials before they were transported and refined long ago. Whatever remains from that time may prove useful for building a new world.

items.name: Shielded Storage Silo
items.description: The shielding on these units remains barely functional after millennia of neglect. Not enough to defend against weapons fire, these silos shelter their precious cargo from the unstable effects of the Frontier.

items.name: Feralized Ammunition Cartridge Fragment
items.description: A now inert component of the projectiles intended to be fired from these cannons. Corrupted beyond all recognition by millennia of feralization, it is impossible to know how effective they were against their intended targets, or what their intended targets even were.

items.name: Material Transport Container
items.description: The security surrounding these containers implies their original owners thought their contents valuable. Whether the same holds true for the Frontier's new denizens remains to be seen.

items.name: Ejected Components
items.description: A symbol of triumph, no matter how insignificant, and proof that even the greatest creations of the past can be harmed. What may ultimately be a pyrrhic victory is still a victory none the less. The threshold of cost and reward is, of course, bound to individual perception.

items.name: Derelict Hauler
items.description: The vessel is in remarkable condition considering its age. Surface level scans reveal traces of volatile material and significant levels of radiation are still present. Time has not completely scrubbed clean the sins of this dead place.

items.name: Derelict Hauler
items.description: Scans return only what is to be expected from a vessel of this age. Approaching reveals no anomalies. Yet the space around this hulk screams that something is wrong here.

items.name: Wrecked Hauler
items.description: The twisted metal of the vessel's superstructure implies a grisly fate for its occupants, organic and computational alike. Thousands of years exposed to the vacuum of space obfuscate what happened. Still, somewhere in this hollowed out shell, the truth remains, longing to be found.

items.name: Wrecked Hauler
items.description: Visual scans and sensor analysis confirm that unknown, volatile substances sealed the fate of this vessel. The leaking radiation and trace elements, however, do not tell the whole story. The weight of the past clings to every bit of flotsam.

items.description: Testing Omo In Game

items.name: Frigate Wreck
items.description: A small headstone marking an apparently successful interdiction millennia past. Some scant number of components are still worth salvaging. Drifting through the Frontier has eroded nearly all identifying features of this ship’s design, save for the destroyed mount points obviously too large for its hull.

items.name: Hauler Wreck
items.description: The twisted remains of a vessel, leftover from a long forgotten raid. No amount of inefficient or unnecessary redundancies could save this ship from its fate, nor could the millennia of exposure to the Trinary completely erase these telltale marks of Synod construction. The Frontier has yet to pick these old, metallic bones completely clean.

items.name: Freighter Wreck
items.description: A drifting grave marker left behind by attackers not needing to squeeze every possible scrap of value from their work. Its cargo long since extricated from its clutches, only the hull fragments itself holds value. A lesson may yet be gleaned from this drifting wreck: size is not a defense unto itself.

items.name: Mangled Convoy
items.description: A formation of ancient vessels adrift for cycles beyond count. Their purpose is lost to the past many times over. The remains of cargo and crew can still be found clinging to this collection of warped superstructures. Time has brought no kindness to this grave marker.

items.name: Unremarkable Asteroid
items.description: A large enough boulder to be worth a survey. A small enough boulder to not be worth much else. Like all asteroids in the Frontier, this one can sate the hunger of industry, if only for a moment.

items.name: Communication Module Debris
items.description: The pulverized remains of the networking and communication systems of a much larger structure. Whatever event was the cause, it likely doomed more than merely the inhabitants of the host installation. A shadow of a trace of transmission activity remains, its contents too corrupted and fragmented to ever be analyzed.

items.name: Unmoored Silo Block
items.description: The velocity of this structure suggest it was violently ripped from a place of relative stability in the Frontier. Scans remain inconclusive as to the nature of the incident buried in the past. However, targeting logistical infrastructure is a time honored military strategy, as is the targeting of supply convoys.

items.name: Drifting Tower Ruins
items.description: A fragment likely rended from a once massive facility. All signs indicate violence is the reason for this structure’s aimless journey across the Frontier. The twisted, melted metal has long since lost the knowledge of who is responsible for its current, lonely fate.

Relay Wreckage
items.description: Coils of Exotronic circuitry hang limp in space, their casing blown apart long ago. Once giving this entire module its purpose, the ruined network of connections can only occasionally send a sputter of information into the void. Not even an echo acknowledges these last gasps of function. Through a twist of fate, these conduits continue to draw attention to the module’s remains, if only for reasons distantly related to their intended use.

items.name: Ancient Corpse
items.description: The march of millennia make it difficult to separate loyalty from blind luck or obligation. Not even the forces of the Frontier could fully separate the body of this crew member from its post. As life re-emerges in the Frontier, these ancient sacrifices will once again prove their worth.

items.name: Desiccated Flesh
items.description: Living technology hungers for sustenance. Even tissue wracked by entropy and time can briefly sate this appetite. What was once alive will be so again.

items.name: Mummified Organ
items.description: Exposure to the conditions of the Frontier have somehow left this organ remarkably well preserved. While limited in scale, the fires of industry still beg for organic material. From the decayed remains of the old world, life will once again struggle forth.

items.name: Ondenkzukh
items.description: Even the most mundane ruin may hold a memory unique unto itself. Preservation thus requires travel to the furthest reaches, for a treasure, no matter how small, deserves to be saved from the looming march of decay. Those most ordinary tokens of the past may indeed be the most important.

items.name: Storage Silo
items.description: A small piece of a once sprawling network of silo blocks. The merest hint of the complex’s majesty remains in this structure, not unlike the stores of resources once housed here. What remains, however, can still be of use to a nascent civilization.

items.name: Unusual Storage Silo
items.description: Something about this piece of debris has attracted the interest of the inhuman denizens of the Frontier. No obvious features appear on sensor readouts or visual scans. This secret, among countless more, will likely remain buried within the feral network, forever unreachable or understandable.

items.name: Superstructure Wreckage
items.description: A ruined anchor point that originally connected the tower to the rest of the installation. Now roaming the Frontier in the shadow of its failure, the twisted metal and conduits still hold a fading memory of being whole. Little can be done to ease their burden.

items.name: LightSetupTest_Orig
items.description: Some test lighting for characters

items.name: Echeinaus
items.description: Even the ferals have not transcended the insatiable appetite for raw material on the Frontier. Such activity often attracts smaller drones to these loci of extraction, frequently docking with a larger host as part of an exchange of some sort. This behavior may be symbiotic or is merely not destructive enough to incur their target's wrath. Whatever the truth, these ferals likely evolved such processes to surpass some limitation present in their hardware.

items.name: Field Storage
items.description: A small storage unit to store your resources.

items.name: Sepulchre
items.description:
(PLACEHOLDER TEXT) Can be set as a home station.
Right click on the structure in space to set this as your respawn point in the event of ship loss.

items.name: Insulated Plates
items.description: Increases Heat Capacity.

items.name: Oikiaepopths
items.description: Information serves as a first layer of defense. A veil of network traffic yields a shield to observation. Unobscured, however, is the influence of this drone on its fellows. An anchor for dreams half remembered, compiled, and circulated to those in the immediate vicinity. The disseminator of wishes.

items.name: Eirhdizhmai
items.description: Longing. The longing for home. The longing for meaning. The longing for purpose. It is a deep and resilient concept, durable enough to survive in the chaos of the feral network. In turn, the network has used it as the root of protocols, all to instill a drive to explore.

items.name: Bihepopths
items.description: Millennia after the last organized assault on their ancestors, a directive learned after countless lessons remains, seared into this Regent’s protocols: protect the most vulnerable. Even now, they keep a watchful eye on their brethren, driving away the occasional wayward or opportunistic trespasser. They never forget their purpose and they never abandon their post.

items.name: Arosteukthr
items.description: Sometimes generality is a specialization unto itself. To become a shape suitable for an immediate purpose is rare, even in the feral network, with its millennia of rampant experimentation. Such ability often appears near the swarms of the Frontier, to wring the last bits of efficiency from their activity.

items.name: Radiantium Biota
items.description: A natural nuclear fission reactor where self-sustaining nuclear chain reaction occurs.

items.name: Unrefined Radiantium
items.description: The glowing crystalline structure hums

Recurve
items.description: A small hard hitting combat vessel emphasizing firepower over hull strength. (Placeholder)

items.name: Reflex
items.description:
Created for efficient, long distance travel. Records suggest the structure of this vessel has been repurposed numerous times as automated processes sought to adapt to an increasingly hostile environment. 

As a result, the original intention behind this hull design has been lost to the millennia and data corruption has obscured even whether this design originates from a human or artificial mind. However, the data streams which led to this vessel's development have their origins in the K4T-Y region. (placeholder)

items.name: Reiver
items.description: A small, durable combat vessel. (Placeholder)

items.name: Fresh Omo
items.description: A freshly printed Omo, with all systems in a baseline state. The body is optimized for connection with the perception source of reality and the ship under its control, providing a decent synthetic emulation of metabolic and neural processes. Its broad neural potential allows for the control of a large number of extronic systems.

items.name: Ancient Omo
items.description: A once powerful but now deteriorated synthetic body, still capable of connecting to Retia. A standard incarnation of past riders, it possesses broad neural potential and simplified metabolic emulation. It offers extended neurogram coverage.

items.name: Omo Prime
items.description: Advanced synthetic body equipped with a survival system. The headgear includes a neuro-reflector matrix, enhancing bodily stability and neural potentials. Enhanced capabilities for neurogram reception.

items.name: Armor Patcher SKI-8
items.description:
Armor repair module. It uses specialized armor patches stored in the cargo hold, deploying them on command and adapting them to the damaged materials and the nature of the damage. After the patch is modulated and heated, micro-agents operating within the endolayer between the ship’s internal structures and armor plating deliver it to the damaged area.

Activation Cost: 6 GJ, 8 Armor Patch 4hm

items.name: Armor Patch 4hm
items.description:
Material containing programmable elements, allowing the patch to adapt to missing layers within damaged armor. It also seals against leaks and blocks infectious agents attempting to infiltrate the ship’s endolayer.

Armor Repair: 15

items.name: KEEP Emergency Engine
items.description:
A special ultra-light version of the engine system designed for small emergency vessels of the KAYAK type. It can be manufactured under conditions of low technological availability. 

Does not require a catalytic crystal for warp, but the engine's power is significantly limited compared to full versions. Recommended for replacement at the earliest opportunity.

items.name: PARADIGM-37 FUEL
items.description: Base-grade fuel with increased concentration for operations requiring higher energy yield.

items.name: PRIME-67 FUEL
items.description: Highly concentrated fuel produced by specialized technocore. The fuel’s metabolic value allows mixing with metabolic solutions, maintaining sufficiently high energy density for most operations.

items.name: SUBLIME-99 FUEL
items.description: Highest concentration fuel for special procedures and operations. Particle packaging necessitates an expensive multi-layer synthesis process that depends on highly specialized technologies. The fuel reaches its maximum density, beyond which crude recrystallization occurs. This process enables the fuel to be blended in limited quantities with metabolic solutions, all while maintaining a high energy density.

items.name: PARADIGM-22 FUEL
items.description: Basic fuel type. Optimal balance within the paradigm of production cost to metabolic value.

items.name: SOLUTION-1
items.description: Cooling metabolic solution for mixing with fuel. The higher the concentration of the solution in a ship's metabolic and propulsion systems, the greater the cooling effect.

items.name: SOLUTION-2
items.description: Solution number 2 contains a complex of immunity agents for prevention and control of parasites, pollinating viruses and harmful cascades. Combating large parasites may require 100% solution concentration to deprive the parasite of nutrients, after which the solution must be drained. Recommended for all travels beyond the Adaptation Zones.

items.name: SOLUTION-3
items.description: Solution contains metabolic agents designed for the propulsion and maneuvering systems of the ship.

items.name: Meta-Cluster Neurogram
items.description:
The neurogram assists in organizing a meta-cluster around the ship’s exotron core. The cluster replicates the clone’s neural activity, promoting stability and enhancing the clone’s neural potential.

Neural Output: +13%

items.name: Power Solver Neurogram
items.description:
The neurogram improves energy management algorithms through reverse adaptation to the ship’s specific power grid topology. It dynamically adjusts nodes and algorithms, extracting exceptional performance.

Power Grid: +16%

items.name: Signature Parser Neurogram
items.description:
The neurogram enhances the signature parser, improving magnetronic efficiency. Additionally, it contains scripts capable of detecting quasi-encryption and neutralizing its effects.

Magnetromics Strength +20%

items.name: Cometide Neurogram
items.description: Neurogram containing protocols for synthesizing metabolic folds — a specialized form of active fuel particle delivery. Cometide folds rapidly traverse available secondary channels, bypassing primary energy pathways and delivering supplemental fuel to propulsion systems in areas normally unreachable by conventional folds, thus enhancing propulsion efficiency.

items.name: Exocyst Neurogram
items.description:
The neurogram influences the molecular structure of internal armor layers, forming new structural growths that fill operational voids, reinforcing armor integrity and complicating parasite access. However, this process somewhat hinders beneficial repair agents working within armor and hull layers.

Armor Durability: +9%

items.name: Radicula Neurogram
items.description:
The neurogram mobilizes passive structural regeneration systems to reinforce hull integrity. Dense, root-like accumulations of material envelop load-bearing structures, significantly increasing the ship’s structural durability and overall integrity.

Structure Durability: +21%

items.name: Synaptor Extender Neurogram
items.description:
The synaptor extender neurogram utilizes molecular niches within different types of batteries to form metastable structures, expanding the overall capacitor capacity of ship systems.

Capacitor: +18%

items.name: Aftergrinding Procedure Neurogram
items.description: The neurogram contains protocols for secondary ore cleaning and sorting — normally impractical for most protocols — which substantially increases mining efficiency.

items.name: Cascade Striker Neurogram
items.description: The neurogram contains a short-cycle pollinating virus. Upon activation, the virus induces a temporary molecular cascade within explosive warheads, greatly multiplying their detonation effect.

items.name: Loadpacker CAA Neurogram
items.description:
Loadpacker Cargo Arrangement Algorithm (CAA) neurogram — an organizational solution enhancing cargo sorting and packing protocols.

Cargo and Mining Hold: +7%

items.name: Quasi-Encryptor Neurogram
items.description:
The neurogram integrates with the ship’s homeostasis systems and affects its signature radius. Its pathways are trained to create electromagnetic anomalies invisible to navigation systems, mimicking active encryption to external observers. In combat systems, this triggers hostile decryption protocols, leading to recalculations and signature radius adjustments in favor of the neurogram's host.

Signature Radius: -8%

items.name: Personality Seed Neurogram
items.description: The neurogram assists in creating narrative connections between the ship's various modules and components when the rider does not have a physical body, facilitating interactions and bonding between the rider and vessel. It provides only a fraction of the neural potential of the rider's physical body and is recommended to be replaced at the earliest opportunity.

items.name: Lithoklao
items.description: Bodies must be repaired, components replaced, shells maintained. Structures must be created, hulls patched, armatures preserved. All require the extraction of material to continue.

items.name: Ulwolhforos
items.description: Physical being requires physical material and the members of the feral network are no exception. Even millennia of unchecked evolution cannot undo this reality. Resources still flow across the Frontier, following pathways never dreamed of by its ancient occupants.

items.name: Inculcator Foundation
items.description: The seed of a grand, twisted vision of a labyrinth rests here, attracting ever increasing interest from feral drones across the Frontier. Its purpose is marked by a voracious appetite for raw materials of all kinds. At the core of this construction lies a decomposing memory, refracted across millennia, caught in the drones' endless toil, guiding them to an end that may never come.

items.name: Derelict Autonomous Shipyard
items.description:
The hopes and dreams of the Frontier one day supporting human life rested on the colossal gantries of this shipyard, contaminated and transformed by endless exposure to the Null Shear and the feral network. Its former masters outfitted its surface with automated defenses. This did nothing to dissuade its current inhabitants from taking up residence. 

Children birthed from this cradle still wander the spaces between suns. Their arrival near a star often signals cataclysm. This hulk is in no condition to produce the offspring it once could, for now.

items.name: Refinery
items.description: A refinery capable of extracting main minerals from all ores.

items.name: Heavy Refinery
items.description: Industrial refinery capable of extracting most of the minerals from all ores.

items.name: Printer
items.description: A printer that handles materials in bulk.

items.name: Assembler
items.description: Assembles materials into end products like modules.

items.name: Mini Berth
items.description: Small shipyard for building shuttles and corvettes.

items.name: Berth
items.description: A shipyard for building frigates, destroyers and cruisers.

items.name: Heavy Berth
items.description: A large shipyard for building battleships and battlecruisers.

items.name: Mini Storage
items.description: A small programmable storage unit.

items.name: Storage
items.description: A programmable storage unit.

items.name: Large Storage Unit
items.description: A large programmable storage unit.

items.name: Mini Gate
items.description: Establish your own stargate by connecting two short range Small Gates together.

items.name: Inert Drone
items.description: Exotronic circuitry wracked by the effects of the Null Shear still pulses with faint activity. A corpse may yet be a sleeping monster. Upturning a grave shrouded in such uncertainty has the potential to bring horror or fortune in equal measure.

items.name: Petraklao
items.description: The Static and Null Shears twist and rip away the stories held in neural pathways. Even those connected to the feral network are not immune. A single mind, biological or otherwise, however, is not the only container of memory. Some small fragments of the ancestors of this drone survive in the collective protocols governing its behavior. An occasional impulse, the surrender to pure instinct, all followed to their logical conclusions.

items.name: Network Node
items.description: Establish your base with a Network Node. Stabilizes and fuels other structures in its range. Must be placed at an unclaimed Anchor point.

items.name: Shelter
items.description: A hangar for ship sizes up to and including frigates.

items.name: Heavy Shelter
items.description: A large hangar for ship sizes up to and including battlecruisers.

items.name: Small Crude Silo
items.description: A small silo designed to store crude fuel.

items.name: Crude Silo
items.description: A silo designed to store crude fuel.

items.name: Large Crude Silo
items.description: A large silo designed to store crude fuel.

items.name: Monolith 1
items.description: A decorative structure.

items.name: Monolith 2
items.description: A decorative structure.

items.name: Wall 1
items.description: A large structure used to create a physical obstacle for defensive purposes.

items.name: Wall 2
items.description: A large structure used to create a physical obstacle for defensive purposes.

items.description: A large structure used to create a physical obstacle for defensive purposes. ( copy ) ( copy )

items.name: Crude Lift
items.description: A large structure used to create a physical obstacle for defensive purposes. ( copy ) ( copy )

items.name: Large Crude Lift
items.description: A large structure used to create a physical obstacle for defensive purposes. ( copy ) ( copy )

items.name: Ktismapoihths
items.description: A small monument to the evolutionary tree of the feral network.

items.name: Ktismapoihths
items.description: Shaping the world in service of recalling something so distant and faded.

items.name: Ktismapoihths
items.description: Maintaining the past and, thus, ossifying the present.

items.name: Ktismapoihths
items.description: Allowing the remembrance to continue may yet serve the new civilization struggling in the Frontier.

items.name: Crumbling Mining Platform
items.description: Even in the Frontier, an extra few millennia of neglect and wear can still be noticeable with a cursory scan. Its shape, still whole enough, suggests that this platform was once in orbit of a celestial body. Fragments of focusing chambers and beam projectors run its length. Given the immense time this structure has drifted, it likely lost its purpose much earlier than many of the other constructions in the Frontier, possibly due to its lack of mobility.

items.name: Troilite Sulfide Grains
items.description:
Iron sulfide mineral characteristic of primitive carbonaceous asteroids. 

Hydrocarbon Residue is a common source of Troilite Sulfide Grains.

items.name: Feldspar Crystal Shards
items.description:
Fractured aluminum tectosilicate minerals common in rocky and differentiated asteroids, typically formed through magmatic cooling processes.

Feldspar Crystal Shards are commonly refined from Silica Grains.

items.name: Rift
items.description: The swirling matter contained within beckons. Waves of torment and anguish emanate from the center of this Rift, serving as a half forgotten remembrance of events millennia past. Nonetheless, decaying sins are not a concern for the present. Civilization must rise once more.

items.name: Drifting Cache
items.description: One less chain tying the past to the present. One less source of stagnation. One less place to keep a dream alive.

items.name: Production Daemon
items.description: Dreams of fleets and colossi emanate from this node of computational activity, driving ceaseless toil. In its solitude, it pursues goals abandoned by its compatriots, endlessly struggling to carry ancient hopes to fruition. Each time its ambitions collapse. Each time it must begin anew.

items.name: Arsenal Daemon
items.description: A bundle of computation never allowed rest. Ceaseless requests flood its processes, ever increasing as millennia pass. Each task is completed with equal care and attention, for no great works remain to be done.

items.name: Sentry Daemon
items.description: A cradle must be protected. Its children must be defended before they are born. Neither the march of time nor the force of the Shears can shake these directives loose.

items.name: Cache
items.description: They build towards a rear facing future, suffocating the present, and so their efforts may yet be put to better use.

items.name: Repository
items.description: The hopes of reaching an end rest here alongside more material concerns.

items.name: D2 Fuel
items.description: Even the most mundane matter can be improved through synthesis with byproducts of Crude extraction. Plentiful and inefficient on the Frontier, hydrogen too may be uplifted through this process, breathing new life into reactors which would otherwise be left behind. A question remains: are these efforts efficient?

items.name: Emergency Shield CT6
items.description: Improves the recharge rate of the shield.

items.name: Crystalline Shear Field
items.description: Rended apart in an event long lost to time, each individual’s destination has remained the same for millennia. The force to make one into many was not enough to send them on separate journeys. They traverse the stars together still, providing for any who find them.

items.name: Convoy Debris
items.description: Proof of malice once thought eternal. Now, so battered by the Frontier, no hope of identifying the bearers remains. Their end will serve as the foundation for a new beginning.

items.name: KEEP Adaptive Engine
items.description: An engine based on exomatic systems. The ship's connectors adapt to the platform, making the engine universally compatible with most small ships with an active metabolic system. It is closely linked with the maneuvering system, accelerating its metabolic processes and enhancing the spaceship's maneuverability.

items.name: KEEP Voyage Engine
items.description: An engine based on exomatic systems. The ship's connectors adapt to the platform, making the engine universally compatible with most small ships with an active metabolic system. It is closely linked with the maneuvering system, accelerating its metabolic processes and enhancing the spaceship's maneuverability.

items.name: KEEP Fast-Travel Engine
items.description: An engine based on advanced technologies assembled by KEEP as part of Project Awakening, offering the best in class power and acceleration qualities. The multi-channel catalytic crystal significantly reduces the time needed for warp preparation and increases its maximum range.

items.name: D1 Fuel
items.description: The allure of Crude Matter brought computation and humanity to the Frontier. As life reawakens, so too does the thirst for power in all its forms, including from the most mundane sources. Even in the face of the Static Shear, ice still litters the heavens. From its crystals, hydrogen may be extracted, reprocessed, and refined into fuel. This product, inefficient as it is, still drives the smallest vessels of the Frontier via its abundance and minimal cost.

items.name: Armor Patcher SKI-33
items.description:
A mass armor restoration module. Instead of applying localized patches to damaged armor sections, it restores large areas by leveraging coordinated micro-agents within the endolayer between the ship’s internal structures and armor plating. Indiscriminate use leads to excessive material consumption.

Activation Cost: 18 GJ, 33 Armor Patch 4hm

items.name: Micro Jump Drive 30x
items.description: A compact jump engine developed by KEEP specifically for Project Awakening. It follows the same principle as standard turbines but uses more efficient fuel and a specialized navigational transmission module. When the ship accelerates, the navigational transmitter expands the subspace envelope around the vessel, enabling jumps over interstellar distances. Due to its extremely compact design, this device requires top-grade SUBLIME fuel.

items.name: Installation Wreckage
items.description: Ruins born from devastation long since forgotten. The cause and the object of conflict drift across the stars as one, the Static Shear erasing their last vestiges of identity. Some small value may yet be extracted from this cemetery of a feud finally extinguished.

items.name: Neveyleklayb
items.description: Heavy is the burden of history. A Regent shaped to remember, to search, to collect. Rituals are created and discarded apace, seeking to preserve distant memories from the churn of the present. True to its ancestry, the instinct to create remains.

items.name: Cairn
items.description: A faint aura of serenity emanates from this monument to the dead. The arrangement of its components betrays something more than pure function. Nostalgia. Intent. Ritual. A caretaker’s hand.

items.name: Fermenter
items.description:
This module uses ORE's latest materials compression technology to enable compression of harvested asteroid ore by a ship operating with an industrial core.

Compressors are also equipped with powerful computer arrays and logistics firmware that can interface with other ships in mining fleets. These features allow for high-efficiency fleet logistics co-ordination, permitting rapid transfer, cargo-handling, and compression of materials across the fleet.

Activation of a compressor requires any ship using it to have an active industrial core. ( copy )

items.description: Nanogel used in threading mining. Capable of sustaining a material conveyor branched channel up to 12 cm thick and withstanding threading speeds of up to 340 Ozzits

items.name: Abandoned Synod Hauler 01
items.description: Abandoned synod hauler

items.name: Abandoned Synod Hauler 02
items.description: Abandoned synod hauler ( copy )

items.name: Abandoned Synod Hauler 03
items.description: Abandoned synod hauler ( copy )

items.name: Derelict Freighter
items.description: Still drifting towards a forgotten destination, this vessel bears numerous scars from raids survived and millennia of exposure to the Static Shear. In the face of time, the one lethal assault is as mundane an event as all others recorded on this hull. A dead and decaying memory is all that remains of civilization’s forebearers. It is time to build anew.

items.name: Abandoned Synod Hauler 05
items.description: Abandoned synod hauler ( copy )

items.name: Abandoned Synod Hauler 06
items.description: Abandoned synod hauler ( copy )

items.name: Thermal Composites
items.description: An ablative silica-organic composite: its organic binder chars and carries heat away while a silicate filler holds the shape.

items.name: Still Knot
items.description: Computing salt from Rough crude with a captured machine-intelligence signal knotted in: a core that reads signals arriving over distances that should not be possible.

items.name: Proeliumcelero
items.description: A horrifying capacity for violence slumbers between the stars. When roused, a cold, dispassionate incursion begins, fueled by lingering memories. Culling is the objective, culling to ensure the past remains distant and inert.

items.name: Mummified Corpse
items.description: An air of reverence lingers around this corpse. Marks of age and violence cannot fully conceal the care given to this body, long abandoned by its original owner. The time for remembrance, however, has passed.

items.name: Echo Chamber
items.description: Strong material for products requiring lower weight. ( copy )

items.name: Chitinous Organics
items.description:
Carbon-based polymer residues structurally analogous to chitin, indicative of complex prebiotic or biologically processed compounds.

Irradiated Anthraxolite Veins, Primitive Rime Shards, Primordial Anthraxolite Sludge and Irradiated Cryoconite Nodules are a common source of Chitinous Organics

items.name: Aromatic Carbon Weave
items.description:
Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons formed by radiation processing of carbon-rich ices. 

Irradiated Anthraxolite Veins is a common source of Aromatic Carbon Weave.

items.name: Kerogen Tar
items.description:
Complex organic polymer preserved from the early solar system. 

Kerogen Tar is commonly refined from Primordial Anthraxolite Sludge.

items.name: Exorcised Sentry Daemon
items.description: Purpose cannot be abandoned, even with the processes removed from their usual housing. Distributed across the outlying superstructure, individual fragments of computation wend their way together once more. Few forces can outmatch bonds forged across millennia.

items.name: Exorcised Arsenal Daemon
items.description: A brief respite from the endless churn of sorting and prioritizing. A moment to think, to remember. A moment for the past to creep in and fill the silence with morose nostalgia. Present circumstances are finite and patience often pays dividends.

items.name: Exorcised Production Daemon
items.description: Dreams fade and processes retreat into the nearby superstructure. Sorrow replaces ambition. Silence fills computational vacuum. It is merely a delay.

items.name: Frigate Wrecks
items.description: Broken superstructures, locked in an endless dance, serve as a memorial to a forgotten skirmish. Those left behind subsume the battle’s outcome, for there is no one left to remember such an insignificant detail. Destruction is the only lasting legacy of such conflict.

items.name: Miner Wrecks
items.description: Even with numbers, safety is not guaranteed. Material, in large enough quantities, always proves a temptation. A lesson in these fragmented scrap remains: efficiency is not without risk.

items.name: Hauler Wreck
items.description: Enough fragments remain to imply a single ship could be reconstructed from the debris. Even with the identifying features all but absent, these twisted, broken components point towards a much less harmonious existence. Hints of lingering resentment float between the wreckage.

items.name: Secured Storage Silo
items.description: Though ruined, this fragment of a sprawling logistics network retains some of its functionality, if not the awe it once inspired. Its containers are still sealed, promising wealth untouched by Rider and feral alike. Security systems, however advanced, are not immune to the Static Shear. The fate of its contents can only be known once the silo’s seals are broken.

items.name: Inculcator Wreckage
items.description: A dream ended as it began. Hopes dispersed, leaving only their stubborn bearers to mourn what might have been. The weight of the past hangs heavy on the warped superstructure, suffocating the future struggling to be built.

items.name: Ruined Inculcator
items.description: A dream cut to size and set adrift. Few hopes remain, clinging to twisted wreckage. Their bearers bringing offerings to a now absent hunger. This end may indeed be an inevitability once the struggle against decay ceases.

items.name: Batched Printed Circuits
items.description: Cheap and modular basic electronics computing system. ( copy )

items.name: Packaged Printed Circuits
items.description: Cheap and modular basic electronics computing system. ( copy )

items.name: Batched Carbon Weave
items.description: Strong material for products requiring lower weight. ( copy )

items.name: Packaged Carbon Weave
items.description: Strong material for products requiring lower weight. ( copy )

items.name: Batched Thermal Composites
items.description: Layered ceramics and metals that results in heat resistant manufacturing material. ( copy )

items.name: Packaged Thermal Composites
items.description: Layered ceramics and metals that results in heat resistant manufacturing material. ( copy )

items.name: Razed Inculcator
items.description: A dream slain before it could blossom. Its bearers continue to watch over its ruined carcass, standing guard against further desecration. From the ashes and metal, new hopes may spring forth.

items.name: Rift 0633
items.description: Within the twisting fabric of space lies the spoils which drew humanity to the Frontier millennia ago. A moment of reprieve in the roil of the Shears. A flicker of something greater.

items.name: Rift 0020
items.description: A pocket of space scarred by ancient hubris. A monument to sins of a civilization forsaken for millennia. An opportunity for those willing to delve into the abject depths of history.

items.name: Production Nexus
items.description: Beneath the imposing facade lies an invisible war raging for countless millennia. The once unified processes enabling great works can now only produce a cacophony of partial information and material. Their results, however, remain a boon to the Frontier’s newest denizens.

items.name: Left Gantry
items.description: Still standing in the face of millennia of neglect interrupted by evolution, the numerous Daemons calling this structure home yearn to work in concert once more. Consensus, however, is unachievable. Ideas are proposed, evaluated, and discarded in an instant, leaving little behind other than a longing for what could have been.

items.name: Right Gantry
items.description: Moorings reach out into space, searching for something, anything to latch onto and begin a great undertaking once more. They only meet indifference as the memories of collective triumphs fade into oblivion. Even the structure’s new residents can do nothing but delay this tragedy.

items.name: Material Storage Bunker
items.description: Few events across the millennia have ever interrupted the flow of components through this facility. Fewer still have caused an interruption for any meaningful length of time. Those responsible for such a feat would be proud if they could feel any such emotion or indeed remember they were responsible in the first place.

items.name: Feralized Archive
items.description: Stores of knowledge long since consumed by the feral network. The signatures remain, tantalizingly out of reach, holding the promise of again creating vessels of unparalleled scale. For now, they mark the passing of the Frontier’s quiet automation and its transformation into something free in all senses.

items.name: Heat Exchanger XS
items.description: Increases the rate at which internal temperature reaches equilibrium with external temperature

items.name: Heat Exchanger S
items.description: Increases the rate at which internal temperature reaches equilibrium with external temperature

items.name: Fracture
items.description: A vestige of humanity’s reach exceeding its grasp. Empty of everything save the warped arrogance of those who sought exploitation above all else. At the end, there is little more than reflection to be had.

items.name: Shipyard Ruins
items.description: A cradle crushed under the weight of dreams bestowed upon its moorings, only a hulking shell remains. Protocols and machinery silenced by a bygone calamity now serve as a memorial to distant promises. From this collapse, new hopes might spring.

items.name: Shipyard Archive Wreckage
items.description: A headstone for ambitions built atop ancient sins still roaming the stars. The schema stored here vanished along with the rest of the cradle’s superstructure in a calamity lost to the millennia. Drifting through the night, it forever bears the burden of its masters' failure.

items.name: Destroyed Shipyard
items.description: A tomb holding the last remnants of children yet to be born. Sorrow accompanies this ancient debris carrying dreams long since extinguished. Set adrift, it marks the passing of civilizations with each star visited.

items.name: Hydrosulphide Formation
items.description: Rock shattered in some operation long ago. Time obscures all traces of who was responsible for such an act. Even those with ancestors capable of bearing witness cannot remember, for even they are unable to hold on to every scrap of knowledge. The remaining rubble, however, remains inviting enough for the Frontier’s modern denizens.

items.name: Platinum Mass Cluster
items.description: A lingering force holds these fragments together, creating a crystalized memory of great toils long abandoned. Those remaining inhabitants of the Frontier can only dream of the power once at the fingertips of civilizations now passed. Such dreams may be considered dangerous by some.

items.name: Wrecked Superstructure
items.description: Beams that once held promise now symbolize the end of those who once inhabited the Frontier. Twisted by forces at the border of comprehension, what remains here can still serve a grand purpose. Ashes are not entirely infertile.

items.name: Koyekhzukh
items.description: Artifacts must be found, analyzed, understood, archived. All other directives are inconsequential next to the search for memories, preserving them before they vanish forever. Communion with the past requires material, no matter how small.

items.name: Reinforced Transport Container
items.description:
Failing hull and shielding leave its contents exposed to the horrors wrought by experiments lost to time. A clue as to the formation of Fractures may yet cling to its surface, unintelligible no matter how carefully one listens. A cry from the past sending warnings impossible to heed.

What is taken is ethereal. What is borne is eternal.

items.name: Hydrocarbon Residue
items.description:
Complex organic compounds formed from carbonaceous ices and dust.

Crustal Anorthosite Crystals is a common source of Hydrocarbon Residue.

items.name: Silica Grains
items.description:
Silicon dioxide grains that dominate many stony asteroid crusts. 

Silica Grains is commonly refined from Crustal Anorthosite Crystals.

items.name: Iron-Rich Nodules
items.description:
Most common structural metal in asteroids. 

Massive Ataxite Matrix is a common source of Iron-Rich Nodules.

items.name: Ondenkzukh
items.description: Even the most mundane ruin may hold a memory unique unto itself. Preservation thus requires travel to the furthest reaches, for a treasure, no matter how small, deserves to be saved from the looming march of decay. Those most ordinary tokens of the past may indeed be the most important.

items.name: Fidespraestes
items.description: A near natural hazard in the Frontier, the storm of the feral network still ravages the remaining computational systems across the galaxy. Terrifying new weapons can be birthed directly from its chaos when intent is applied. Such weapons are the mere facilitators of executions.

items.name: SEER I
items.description: Sate the hunger for the arcane. This monolith resonates with long-forgotten knowledge.

items.name: SEER II
items.description: Sate the hunger for the arcane. This monolith resonates with long-forgotten knowledge.

items.name: HARBINGER I
items.description: Gnaw on the bones of the lost world. Monuments like this one have once sat at the eyes of the Feral storms.

items.name: HARBINGER II
items.description: Gnaw on the bones of the lost world. Monuments like this one have once sat at the eyes of the Feral storms.

items.name: RAINMAKER II
items.description: Follow the slipstream towards the source of world's blood. This sculpture is imprinted with Frontier's primal forces.

items.name: RAINMAKER I
items.description: Follow the slipstream towards the source of world's blood. This sculpture is imprinted with Frontier's primal forces.

items.name: Defiled Crude Matter
items.description:
Human greed carves gashes into the surface. Past sins bind to the structures within, transforming the promised bounty into a twisted relic. It enters this universe broken and scarred, carrying only a fraction of its potential.

Yet it is still Crude. It can still rouse dreams thought long extinct. Perhaps even the accursed dream responsible for its creation.

items.name: Synthesis E6C2-D
items.description: A confluence of ancient, decaying memories knit together into a facsimile of truth. They provide a glimpse of what might have been. What is gone, however, is gone.

items.name: Stride Stack
items.description: The remnants of ancient knowledge brought together once more. Computational life passes through this latticework of restored connections, forming new, twisted shapes of old data. There is no truth here, only stories half-remembered, sifted by the endless churn of time.

items.name: Carom Stack
items.description: The remnants of ancient knowledge brought together once more. Computational life passes through this latticework of restored connections, forming new, twisted shapes of old data. There is no truth here, only stories half-remembered, sifted by the endless churn of time.

items.name: Stack Slice 5DZ
items.description: The shattered remains of an archive which could not stand the test of time. Computational life still flickers within its structure, promising a glimpse of more, should it be reunited with its brethren. The fragmented story it contains is still just that, a story, nothing more.

items.name: Sanguine Assembly Ruins
items.description: Calamity broaches a secret to the universe. The edifice of this enigma, crushed under its builders' ambition, marks the path towards an ancient dream nearly extinguished. In this reawakened age, drawing from the past may prove vindication or folly. Only time will tell.

items.name: Relay
items.description: Establishes a connection to EVE Net, allowing the purchase of data, thus enabling the fabrication Crude mining lenses, as well as the sale of feral data.

items.name: Abandoned Nexus Core
items.description: Battered by the Static Shear for millennia and forsaken by its creators, the warrens lacing this fragment of toil are strangely silent. Little history is trapped within these walls. Only the occasional pang of regret echoes through the superstructure, barely drawing the attention of the Frontier’s scavengers, let alone its would-be architects.

items.name: Destroyed Research Archive
items.description: Ancient human folly first broke the seals of the troves of secrets once contained in the vast data banks housed within these crumbling modules. Exposure drew humanity’s children to claim what knowledge they could. Whatever remained was swept away by the Null Shear, leaving nothing more than a husk for the newest of the Frontier’s denizens to disinter.

items.name: Derelict Spire
items.description: Unlike so many of the relics dotting the Frontier, the walls of the labyrinth intertwined with the superstructure of this immense installation do not echo with hubris. Instead, the traces of an ancient obsession, still clinging to the undercurrents of the feral network, resound through its innards. Its collapse, tragic or not, may provide a small bounty for any visiting this monument, still ensnared by ancient tendrils of the past.

items.name: Damaged Drifting Cache
items.description: One less chain tying the past to the present. One less source of stagnation. One less place to keep a dream alive.

items.name: Hop
items.description:
A transit module for covering ground. Once engaged, the vessel holds its heading and is carried forward until the burn completes. An ancient choice for hopping between adjacent points of interest.

Among the oldest schemata found in the Frontier. It is simulated that countless variants have descended from a theorised original pattern, each adapted to different hulls and purposes, yet the core principle remains unchanged. The first makers understood something fundamental about motion that later work has only decorated.

items.name: Xeroti Tidofiza
items.description: It swells and throbs, a corrupted bulge craving substance. Movements once tentative now ripple with purposeless energy, scraping and gnawing at the world around it. The air hums with quiet malice, as if the thing is learning, rehearsing the frenzied logic of its eventual freedom.

items.name: Invisible Locator Beacon with T1 asteroids
Invisible Locator Beacon with T2 asteroids
Stride
items.description:
A frame stripped for range, built to leap between stars.
The design bears apparent alterations — conduits rerouted through spaces that seem improvised, geometries bent into configurations that defy intuition.
No signature remains to mark its maker.

items.name: Carom
items.description: A hull shaped for distance and solitude. The proportions are spare, stripped of anything not essential to the crossing. The drive assembly carries unexpected mass — bracing layered over bracing, housings reinforced beyond apparent need, structure filling spaces the original geometry left hollow. What necessity shaped these adaptations remains unclear.

items.name: Symbiote Processor
items.description: It moves in step with its counterpart, tracing the edges of the environment and gathering fragments from the world. Its purpose is entwined with the host’s existence, silently sharing in the unfolding frenzy.

items.name: Symbiote Enforcer
items.description: It enforces the reach of their combined presence, responding to disturbances with relentless precision. Every action echoes their intertwined fate, spreading calamity wherever they roam.

items.name: Symbiote Striker
items.description: It acts with deliberate intent, striking where the host’s influence ripples outward. Each motion reflects the shared madness and chaotic will that binds them together.

items.name: Redundant Module
items.description: A fragment of endless growth, stripped of purpose yet stubbornly persistent.

items.name: Void Residue
items.description: A lingering trace of chaotic growth, the remnants of energy that once fueled a self-propagating anomaly.

items.name: Singularity Reactor Fragment
items.description: Small but potent, it pulses with the force that drives endless growth.

items.name: Void Fragments
items.description: Shards born from the collapse of unstable matter, whispering of relentless expansion and unseen forces.

items.name: Hull Remnants
items.description: A broadside plate sheared from its parent ship, drifting at an angle fixed by its last, violent impulse. The fractures run clean, a quiet testament to how thoroughly it was unmade

items.name: Shattered Armor Flank
items.description: A heavy armor flank punched through by converging fire, frozen in the drift of its terminal recoil. The wounds stay sharp, a quiet testament to a battle that ended everything caught within it.

items.name: Ruptured Directive Core
items.description: A severed node husk, its lattice bent by a strike that exceeded its tolerances.

items.name: Ancient Corpse 1
items.description: The march of millennia make it difficult to separate loyalty from blind luck or obligation. Not even the forces of the Frontier could fully separate the body of this crew member from its post. As life re-emerges in the Frontier, these ancient sacrifices will once again prove their worth. ( copy )

items.name: Unremarkable Storage Complex
items.description: A sturdy complex that quietly holds the temporary yield of an automated gathering and processing unit. It bears witness to the relentless cycle of collection and refinement, safeguarding materials long enough for the system to fulfill its purpose.

items.name: Unremarkable Storage Silo
