items.description: A partial entry whose formatting collapsed long ago; the header code suggests an age older than the battlefield itself.

items.name: Trace M3K-19A
items.description: A brittle thought-sequence with looping metadata; the naming block predates most current indexing systems.

items.name: Trace R1U-72C
items.description: A fractured mnemonic snippet preserved through chance; its checksum style belongs to a forgotten era.

items.name: Log Q4N-120X
items.description: A heavily formalized register with timestamp drift across all layers; its structure aligns with protocols abandoned ages past.

items.name: Log W5C-417R
items.description: A disciplined ledger warped by long-term bit-rot.

items.name: Log K8F-332L
items.description: A high-order procedural entry partly preserved in hardened storage.

items.name: Symbiote Scout
items.description: It moves in step with its counterpart, tracing the edges of the environment and gathering fragments from the world. Its purpose is entwined with the host’s existence, silently sharing in the unfolding frenzy.

items.name: Inner Derelict Bay
items.description: The primary structure of this megasite is accompanied by an array of supporting facilities and defies convenient survey, its interior subdivisions visible only in fragments through breached sections. External observation suggests compartmentalization on a scale consistent with mass production, though of what remains unclear. Thermal variations across the hull indicate processes still occurring within, their nature a matter of speculation. Approach routes show signs of recent traffic.

items.name: Inner Derelict Quarry
items.description: A dense cluster of stone anchors this site, its surfaces marked by extraction scars of varying age. A derelict outpost maintains position nearby, its structures oriented toward the rocks in a posture of sustained attention. Conveyance systems hold material at stages of processing that imply sequence, though the logic of that sequence has grown opaque. Signatures occasionally flicker through the installation in patterns too brief to trace.

items.name: Inner Stone Cluster
items.description: Stone gathers here in densities particular to the inner regions, fragments maintaining proximity rarely observed farther from the sun. The clustering follows no evident organizing principle, yet persists against the gradual forces that should disperse it. Such concentrations occur throughout these reaches, each arrangement distinct in its particulars. What holds these stones in congregation remains a matter of observation rather than explanation.

items.name: Inner Ancient Cluster
items.description: The oldest formations congregate here, their mass compacted by pressures that predate local memory. Compositions within these stones have had eons to settle into densities that discourage investigation. The surfaces carry markings consistent with age—fractures sealed by time, deposits layered over deposits. These stones arranged themselves long before anything arrived to observe them, and carry that priority in their structure.

items.name: Char
items.description:
Charred remnants of volcanic crust, these fire-scarred asteroids contain crystalline feldspar minerals forged in the intense heat of differentiated parent bodies. Their burnt, weathered surfaces hide valuable aluminum and silicon-rich crystals beneath layers of space-weathered rock.

Char asteroids are a common source of Feldspar Crystals  and can typically be found in Inner Belts.

items.name: Slag
items.description:
Industrial waste from the cosmos—metallic slag asteroids are the leftover cores of shattered worlds. Rich in platinum and palladium, these slowly-cooled metallic matrices represent the most precious remnants of planetary formation, concentrated in dense nickel-rich grains.

Slag asteroids are a common source of  Platinum-Palladium Matrix and can typically be found in Inner Belts.

items.name: Ingot
items.description:
Pure metallic ingots drifting through space, these asteroids are nature's own refined metal bars. Containing the densest materials known—iridium, osmium, and ruthenium—they're the treasure vaults of the asteroid belt, forged in the deepest, hottest cores of primordial worlds.

Ingot asteroids are a common source of Iridosmine Nodules.

items.name: Comet
items.description:
Primitive water-bearers from stellar formation, these comet-like asteroids hold preserved secrets in their hydrated sulfide cores. Part ice, part metal, they're time capsules of aqueous chemistry now frozen in the void.

Comet asteroids are a common source of Hydrated Sulfide Matrix and can typically be found in Outer Belts.

items.name: Dewdrop
items.description:
Delicate spheres of frozen volatiles, dewdrop asteroids glisten with crystalline methane ice preserved at near-absolute-zero temperatures. These fragile outer belt wanderers are reservoirs of pure cryogenic fuel, waiting to be harvested from the cold reaches of space.

Dewdrop asteroids are a common source of Methane Ice Shards.

items.name: Ember
items.description:
Still glowing with primordial organic heat, ember asteroids contain pristine kerogen—complex carbon polymers that have remained unaltered since formation. These dark, coal-like bodies hold valuable chemical building blocks.

Ember asteroids are a common source of Primitive Kerogen Matrix.

items.name: Glint
items.description:
Shimmering with rainbow-like iridescence, glint asteroids sparkle with veins of complex aromatic hydrocarbons. Radiation-forged through extended exposure, their surfaces gleam with polycyclic organic compounds—the cosmic equivalent of liquid crystal displays, beautiful and chemically exotic.

Glint asteroids are a common source of Aromatic Hydrocarbon Veins.

items.name: Soot
items.description:
Dark as coal dust and deeply primordial, soot asteroids are coated in prebiotic tholin nodules—tar-like organic compounds formed through radiation chemistry. These sooty spheres are laboratories of cosmic chemistry, their surfaces slowly processing in the radiation of deep space.

Soot asteroids are a common source of Tholin Nodules.

items.name: Palladium
items.description: A rare platinum-group metal used in high-grade alloys and electronics.

items.name: Feral Trace
items.description: A remnant of curiosity left behind after its owner snatched the objects of its desire. Now isolated from its host, the tendrils of thought and feeling exploring its new home grasp at anything nearby to enumerate. What threat can bottled wonderment alone pose?

items.name: Inner belt - Derelict Ruins ( copy )
items.description: Structures hold position in the void, their silence the silence of matter long since spent. Damage and slow accretion have obscured original geometries, though angular profiles still cut against the starfield. Breach points across multiple hulls speak only to endings—sudden or gradual, the distinction now irrelevant. Atmospheres equalized with the void in some prior era, leaving interiors exposed to whatever might find them. These installations offer no explanation for their presence, and the quiet within them invites speculation. ( copy )

items.name: Calamitous Marrow
items.description: Chaos permeates the Frontier at all scales, converting stabilizing forces into agents of transformation. The evolutionary havoc pulsing through the trabeculae of this substance tantalizes with the possibilities it may unlock. Its desirable qualities, in turn, ensure its rarity, for the conditions which lead to its creation are impossible to replicate.

items.name: Terminal
items.description:
This terminal does not appear fully dormant. It continues to observe its surroundings, registering the presence of nearby matter with slow, deliberate scans.
Most offerings pass without response. Most are examined and then ignored. Calamitous Marrow, however, is consistently drawn inward, after which a reward is ejected in response.

items.name: Logistics Unit
items.description:
A remnant of an ancient logistics network, long since vanished. These drones still traverse the Frontier, carrying and exchanging goods according to protocols that no longer have an owner.
They arrive without signal.
They trade.
They depart without explanation.
The system they serve is gone.
The function remains

items.name: Caird
items.description: What is lost in flexibility is gained in simplicity. Routine tasks require only basic functionality to be present. These functions, though trivial, still lay the foundations from which complexity may flourish.

items.name: Luthier
items.description: The feralization of the Conservators appears to have only bolstered their desire to protect the work of their ancestors. They themselves, however, have likely transcended the need for these structures. Computational evolution remains a mirror for its biological counterpart.

items.name: Ostler
items.description: The great works of the past would have vanished millennia ago if not for the toil of the remaining denizens of the Frontier. Even as their tools stave off the inevitable, their ancient masters likely would not recognize the fruits of their labor. Persistence abets preservation.

items.name: Wright
items.description: The tools of creation are no less capable of harm than those purpose-built for destruction, for creation itself is often a violent act. Those who wield these instruments of artistry can therefore be easily turned to the pursuit of combat. Battle is a craft unto itself, after all.

items.name: Shambler
items.description: They protect their charges with the power of a being evolved for war. What conflict bore such weapons is long lost to history. How they chose their current wards is an even deeper enigma.

items.name: Dowser
items.description: Deep and resilient, the concept of longing has survived the roiling informational chaos for millennia. From the resulting milieu of data, desires for meaning, for truth, and for home emerge. This ontogenesis may explain why even the most mundane of feral drones tirelessly search the stars.

items.name: Scrivener
items.description: The materials of the past aid the maintenance of the present. This assumption drives the systematic search across the stars for even the smallest scrap of viable matter. What appears as curiosity likely is a function of pure persistence, nothing more.

Time breeds malice enough to bond to structure, hull, and turret; strengthening the whole.

items.name: Skip
items.description:
A transit module for covering ground. Once engaged, the vessel holds its heading and is carried forward until the burn completes. An ancient choice for hopping between adjacent points of interest.

Among the oldest schemata found in the Frontier. It is simulated that countless variants have descended from a theorised original pattern, each adapted to different hulls and purposes, yet the core principle remains unchanged. The first makers understood something fundamental about motion that later work has only decorated. ( copy )

items.name: Crude - Young/Fine
items.description:
Tight weaves of energetic currents tangle and dissipate beneath the surface. Deeper, they merge so seamlessly as to appear singular in nature, concealing the true chaos seething within. The hue surrounding the matter subtly reflects this hidden truth, oscillating wildly between wave forms.

It is chaos which offers potential, enticing all who might stumble upon its power. So tempting is the possibility that risks may be easily ignored.

items.name: Rift F935
items.description: A mere hint of the Frontier’s bounty rests within this folding fabric of space. It is barely enough to satiate the youngest inhabitants of the galaxy. Little more than a taste of possibility can be found here.

items.name: Crude - Old/Fine
items.description:
Dense braids of tranquil, potent energy dance across the surface. Within, they ply together as if seeking to become one. From this unmet desire, the fuel of dreams might be extracted, as practiced by those long passed.

The ethereal beauty of transience emanates from compacting, ever-shifting weaves of sinew. Appreciation goes beyond immediate need and can therefore be discarded.

items.name: Rift 05D8
items.description: Within this pocket of space lies a mere fragment of the spoils which first drew humanity to the Frontier. Its present quantity offers no more than a chance at survival. Little more than a flicker of hope exists here.

items.name: Still Kernel
items.description: Crystallised computing salt grown from crude. A porous ionic lattice whose ordered defects hold a state.

items.name: Shell Pool 47
items.description:
Dead silent, the outer hull bears the signs of refuge. Its builders long gone.
Beyond the sealed partitions lie vast growth chambers arranged with clinical precision. The proportions are familiar. Uncomfortably so.
Whatever was cultivated here was not born — it was grown.

items.name: Grave Watcher
items.description:
Constructed in memory of old threats, these structures stand silently in their triumph. Their eternal vigil may yet find targets once thought extinct. Trespassers are not suffered lightly.

Time breeds malice enough to bond to structure, hull, and turret; strengthening the whole.

items.name: Fell Watcher
items.description:
Constructed in memory of old threats, these structures stand silently in their triumph. Their eternal vigil may yet find targets once thought extinct. Trespassers are not suffered lightly.

Passing millennia foster malevolence enough to permeate structure, hull, and turret; sharpening the whole.

Beyond the sealed partitions lie vast growth chambers arranged with clinical precision. The proportions are familiar. Uncomfortably so.

items.name: Field Cairn
items.description:
A Field Cairn is deployable anchor that fixes a signature to an exact point in space for those intending to return.

Cairns lack stabilizing thrusters and are inherently unstable, gradually degrading and drifting out of orbit within 24 hours.

items.name: Hellier
items.description: At scale, tools of construction possess a destructive potential indistinguishable from weapons of war. The wielders of these tools may lack creative instincts but they make effective use of their instruments to raze impediments all the same. In absence of direction or coordination, this capacity for brutality may surpass even their more purpose-built, bellicose kin.

items.name: Mycena
items.description: Menial tasks are the charge of those who chase great dreams. All pursuits of perfection trace themselves back to these mundane origins. When left alone, those striving towards such goals may well blossom into something more.

items.name: Knife
items.description: A direct energy tool useful for breaking apart solid matter. Like many of its forebearers, it can serve needs beyond its intended purpose. Adaptation is necessary for survival. ( copy )

items.name: Dermestid
items.description: One more step towards perfection. Such a moving target may never be reached, but there is meaning in the mere act of striving for the sublime, or so some of the denizens of the Frontier seem to believe.

items.name: Thrumming Strand
items.description: Driven by a sliver of the consciousness of its creator, it slithers around its container awaiting a purpose. Energy arcs from the thread of its body to any nearby objects, hinting at the possibilities and dangers locked within its form. In time, it may well become a creator, of sorts, in its own right.

items.name: Drained Strand
items.description: Its purpose fulfilled, only a wisp of its former shape remains. Gone are the slivers of consciousness, the thrumming energy. What lingers is still an agent of change, if not transcendence.

items.name: Chrysalis
items.description: A complex life requires moments of vulnerability. One such moment stirs within this silent mass of potential, waiting to burst free. Should too many cracks appear, the moment vanishes forever along with all the dangers and riches it may have brought forth.

items.name: Emergency Printer
items.description: Provides onboard fabrication of small structural components and parts from raw material inputs.

items.name: Weapon Receiver
items.description: Internal structural housing that accepts external weapons through integrated hardpoint connections.

items.name: Cargo Container
items.description: Sealed storage bay for carrying cargo within the structure. Each fitted module increases the total cargo hold capacity.

items.name: Hull Repairer
items.description: Automated repair system that restores hull integrity over time while activated.

items.name: Cutting Laser
items.description: Multi purpose, Short-range cutting laser mounted on an external weapon hardpoint. Can be activated to mine, salvage or fend off minor threats.

items.name: Power Generator
items.description: Generates and distributes electrical power to the onboard powergrid, allowing for on-lining of modules.

items.name: Leap
items.description: High-energy propulsion unit enabling rapid short-range directional bursts of speed when activated.

items.name: Propulsion Engine R10
items.description: Primary drive unit providing sustained thrust. Provides multiple hardpoints slots for External Thrusters.

items.name: Ion Sensor
items.description: Monitors local signatures passively for resolving unknown entities with EM signatures.

items.name: Directional Scanner
items.description: External scanning array for active directional resolution of unknown ships, structures, and anomalies.

items.name: Command Pod
items.description: Central command unit housed in the root section of the structure, coordinating all onboard systems.

items.name: Fuel Bay
items.description: Pressurized storage tank for fuel reserves used by the Power Generator. Each fitted module increases the total fuel storage.

items.name: Capacitor
items.description: Energy buffer that stores and supplies charge to support activation of modules. Also serves as a  backup for the Power Generator should it temporarily go offline. Each fitted module increses the total power capacity.

items.name: External Thruster
items.description: Supplemental thrust unit attached to a Propulsion Engine hardpoint. Each fitted module increases the top velocity of the ship.

items.name: Slough
items.description: A marker of transcendence abandoned and set adrift. What remains must no longer be needed by the entity which tore this vessel asunder. The faint residue coating the wreckage may yet provide an opportunity for those that heed not the warning implied by the presence of this casket.

items.name: Homeostatic Inoculation
items.description: Removes any form of trauma from a shell.

items.name: Thermal Salve
items.description: Removes build up of conflagration. Immediately stops any active conflagration. Prevents new conflagration build up for some time.

items.name: Psyche Inoculation
items.description: Removes build up of feralization. Immediately stops any active feralization. Prevents new feralization build up for some time.

items.name: Utility Container
items.description: A small wreckage container prepared to hold Utility Component A.

items.name: Component Locker
items.description: A small wreckage container prepared to hold Sensor Component A.

items.name: Fuel Cell
items.description: A small wreckage container prepared to hold Unstable Fuel.

items.name: Emergency Processor
items.description: Provides onboard processing of ore, salvage, and parts into base materials.

items.name: Crude Extractor
items.description: Extracts valuable Crude Matter by drawing exotic material through a Crude Rift.

items.name: Mycena
items.description: Menial tasks are the charge of those who chase great dreams. All pursuits of perfection trace themselves back to these mundane origins. When left alone, those striving towards such goals may well blossom into something more.

items.description: Boosts external maneuvering thrusters at the cost of increased fuel consumption.

items.description: Increases the strength of EM signatures.

items.name: Approach Computer
items.description: When activated, this module automatically flies the ship towards the selected locked target.

items.name: Stuttergun
items.description: A rapid-fire projectile gun. A tough barrel contains each shot, a heat frame sheds the firing heat, and a salvaged board times the bursts.

items.name: Transfuser
items.description: When activated on a locked target ship, transfers fuel from your ship's fuel bay into the target ship's fuel bay each cycle. Some fuel is lost in the transfer process.

items.name: Autohelm
items.description: While fitted and powered on, this computer allows automatic approach to objects in space.

items.name: Needle
items.description: Short-range combat laser mounted on an external weapon hardpoint. Can be activated to inefficiently mine or salvage but is more effective at fending off threats or initiating combat.

items.name: Thrust Overdrive
items.description: Interior propulsion assist module that burns fuel directly to add thrust above the Engine and Thruster baseline. Boost scales with fuel impulse and online Thruster count; full ship maneuverability is maintained while active.

items.name: Launch Bay
items.description: A storage module that ejects a payload into space. On activation, transfers heat from the ship into the charge and deploys it from the hull. Compatible with any Payload.

items.name: Heat Trap
items.description:
A payload deployed from a Launch Bay. On release it draws excess heat off your ship, then drifts and cools toward the surrounding temperature over its Cooling Period.

Destroying a Heat Trap vents its Stored Heat as a Thermal Discharge: radial thermal damage to every ship in range - allies and your own ship included. The hotter the trap when it dies, the stronger the discharge. While above its Volatility Threshold the trap is Volatile and cannot be scooped; once cooled below the threshold it turns inert and can be recovered.

Structurally fragile - any damage destroys it.

items.name: Rupture - Young/Fine/Low
items.description:
Currents of energy flicker almost playfully just beneath the surface. Deeper, the flows meld, forming a sea of emotion. 
The hue surrounding the matter changes with these internal tides, reflecting whichever passion dominates in the moment.
It is this mercurial nature which entices, which promises the ability to shape the future. So sweet is the call that danger, no matter how apparent, is easily ignored.

items.name: Transponder
items.description: While broadcasting, announces an identification signal on a chosen channel - tribe or a set code - and marks other broadcasting ships in range as friend or foe. Broadcasting significantly increases the ship's EM emissions.

items.name: Fuel Blister
items.description: An auxiliary tank plumbed into the lowest point of the ship's fuel system. While online it extends the ship's fuel capacity; taken offline it seals shut, holding its share of the fuel until it is brought back online. Draws no power.

items.name: Phase Reagent
items.description: Removes build up of temporalization. Immediately stops any active temporalization. Prevents new temporalization build up for some time.

items.name: Transponder Beacon
items.description: A high-output identification beacon. When lit, the ship is held stationary and broadcasts a warpable rally point to every pilot in the solar system whose own transponder is actively operating with a matching code.

items.name: Blackstart Cell
items.description: An auxiliary capacitor bank faced with photothermal collectors. Gleans a slow trickle of charge from ambient starlight - nothing arrives in shadow, warp or the dark - and the trickle stops once the reserve's own share of the capacitor is full. Needs no fuel, power or CPU, so it keeps working on an otherwise dead ship. The stored charge is lost if the module is removed.

items.name: Field Sentry
items.description: A simple defensive system which can be deployed anywhere. Onboard power is finite and will only function for a limited time.

items.name: Psyche Veil
items.description: Increases shell resistance to feralization.

items.name: Phase Cerement
items.description: Increases shell resistance to temporalization.

items.name: Moon Eater
items.description: This gigantic superstructure was built by the effort of thousands of rogue drones. While the structure appears to be incomplete, its intended shape remains a mystery to the clueless carbon-based lifeforms.

items.name: Docking Clamp
items.description: While fitted and powered on, this electromagnetic clamp lets the ship anchor itself to a docking port. Activate it to reveal the ports around you, then interact with the port when in range.

items.name: Organics
items.description: Tarry carbon compounds, the kind found in dark meteorites. They burn readily.

items.name: Carbon
items.description: Pure carbon, anywhere from soot to graphite. It conducts, and it burns.

items.name: Carbon Dioxide
items.description: Frozen carbon dioxide, the same stuff as dry ice. It soaks up heat as it turns to gas.

items.name: Chromite-spinel
items.description: Black chromium-iron oxide that stands up to heat.

items.name: Copper
items.description: Soft red metal that carries current and heat.

items.name: Feldspar
items.description: Pale, glassy silicate, the commonest mineral in rocky crusts.

items.name: Platinoids
items.description: Platinum and its kin, metals that never tarnish. Very dense, and they speed up reactions without being used up.

items.name: Ilmenite
items.description: Black iron-titanium oxide, the mineral titanium is mined from. Dense for a stone, and it conducts a little when light hits it.

items.name: Iron sulfide
items.description: Iron and sulfur, the bronze-coloured mineral common in meteorites.

items.name: Light Volatiles
items.description: Frozen methane, with carbon monoxide and ammonia mixed in. Quick to turn to gas, quick to burn.

items.name: Nickel-iron
items.description: Iron-nickel metal, the stuff of iron meteorites.

items.name: Olivine
items.description: Magnesium-iron silicate, green when pure. Clear crystals of it are the gem peridot.

items.name: Schreibersite
items.description: Iron-nickel phosphide, a brassy mineral found almost only in meteorites. Magnetic, and it conducts.

items.name: Silica
items.description: Silicon dioxide, the stuff of quartz and glass.

items.name: Silicon carbide
items.description: Silicon and carbon bonded into one of the hardest materials known. It moves heat fast and holds its shape where most things melt.

items.name: Tetrataenite
items.description: Iron and nickel set into a neat, ordered crystal by ages of slow cooling.

items.name: Water
items.description: Plain ice, plus water locked inside wet minerals.

items.name: Regolith Collector
items.description:
Mining a composite body sheds regolith faster than any pilot can gather it by hand. This module sweeps a wide cone ahead of the ship, drawing loose regolith into the cargo hold a few fragments at a time for as long as it runs.

It has no grip on anything but loose regolith, and no patience for a full hold.

items.name: Collier
items.description: They spin pieces of the world into objects fit for maintaining their inheritance. Beauty may be found in the environs they have carved their way through. Art might yet emerge from their desecration of the Frontier as they attempt to preserve their ancient master’s legacy.

items.name: Shifter
items.description: The carcass of the world still holds flesh to be given a new purpose: caring for what remains. Even the smallest scrap is worth assimilating into both the old and the new. Their inheritance is too important to see fall further into ruin.

items.name: Propulsion Engine R25
items.description: Primary drive unit providing sustained thrust. Provides multiple hardpoints slots for External Thrusters.

items.name: Propulsion Engine R50
items.description: Primary drive unit providing sustained thrust. Provides multiple hardpoints slots for External Thrusters.

items.name: Propulsion Component Locker [Player flow test]
items.description: A small wreckage container prepared to hold a Propulsion Component.

items.name: Machinery Crate
items.description: A small wreckage container prepared to hold Mining Components.

items.name: Sensor Component Locker [Player flow test]
items.description: A small wreckage container prepared to hold a Sensor Component.

items.name: Inoculation Supply Locker
items.description: A small wreckage container prepared to hold Psyche Inoculation doses.

items.name: Conservator Asteroid Mining Spawner Easy Escort
Refueling Dock [Player flow test]
items.description: A small wreckage container prepared to hold Unstable Fuel. ( copy )

items.name: Conservator Asteroid Mining Spawner Hard Escort
Conservator Salvage Mining Spawner Easy Escort
Conservator Salvage Mining Spawner Hard Escort
Printer
items.description: Provides onboard fabrication across the full component, module and munitions catalogue. Requires substantially more hull volume than an Emergency Printer.

items.name: Refinery
items.description: Provides onboard reprocessing across the full range of salvage, ore and exotic organics. Requires substantially more hull volume than an Emergency Processor.

items.name: Supply Dock
items.description: A supply quay offering Unstable Fuel and cargo.

items.name: Fueling Dock
items.description: A fueling quay carrying Unstable Fuel.

items.name: Industry Printer
items.description:
A field fabricator that runs Industry schemas. Where a conventional printer stamps out identical copies, this one reads the properties of whatever you feed it and carries them into the product - the same schema with different feedstock gives a different module.

Fit it to your ship, then open the Keeper menu on the left and select Industry.

items.name: Access Dock
items.description: An access quay reserved for the Creche Hauler. Docking opens its own container.

items.name: Access Dock
items.description: An access point to a derelict Hauler, stocked with mining components.

items.name: Access Dock
items.description: An access port stocked with Unstable Fuel.

items.name: Damaged Drifting Cache
items.description: One less chain tying the past to the present. One less source of stagnation. One less place to keep a dream alive.

items.name: Racing Leap
items.description: High-energy propulsion unit enabling rapid short-range directional bursts of speed when activated. Tuned for racing, it keeps far more steering control while boosting.

items.name: Inkstone
items.description: Dark, carbon-bearing rock built mostly of Olivine.

items.name: Bitumen
items.description: Tarry rock, thick with Organics.

items.name: Greenstone
items.description: Green, water-worked rock, mostly Serpentine.

items.name: Adamant
items.description: Carbon-rich rock, mostly Silicon carbide.

items.name: Fieldstone
items.description: Ordinary stony rock, mostly Olivine and Pyroxene with flecks of metal.

items.name: Clinker
items.description: Slaggy mix of stone and metal, mainly Pyroxene and Nickel-iron.

items.name: Pyroxenite
items.description: Rock made mostly of Pyroxene, with a little metal.

items.name: Brimstone
items.description: Sulfide rock, mostly Iron sulfide.

items.name: Basalt
items.description: Volcanic rock, mostly Pyroxene and Feldspar.

items.name: Lampblack
items.description: Sooty rock, rich in Carbon.

items.name: Bloom
items.description: Raw iron-nickel metal, nearly all of it Nickel-iron.

items.name: Floe
items.description: Dirty ice, mostly Water, with rock and organic tar frozen through it.

items.name: Noble
items.description: Dense metal rock carrying the platinum metals.

items.name: Ochre
items.description: Rust-coloured rock, mostly Magnetite.

items.name: Peridotite
items.description: Green rock from deep inside a body that once melted, mostly Olivine.

items.name: Evaporite
items.description: Pale salt rock, left behind by water that dried away.

items.name: Hoarfrost
items.description: Loose frost of light ices, mostly Light Volatiles.

items.name: Pyroxene
items.description: Dark, blocky magnesium-iron silicate, common in volcanic rock and meteorites.

items.name: Magnetite
items.description: Black, magnetic iron oxide, the mineral lodestones are made of.

items.name: Serpentine
items.description: Soft green mineral that forms when water works on Olivine.

items.name: Salts
items.description: Rock salt and the other minerals brine leaves when it dries.

items.name: Armilla
items.description: A step towards making a great dream reality. The pursuit of perfection is an endless process of minor improvements, compounding into something beautiful. Even with melioration, any beauty here remains vulnerable in the pursuit of the sublime, however futile it might be.

items.name: Calliphor
items.description: Navigating the path towards perfection requires variation in strategy. At times, mere threats may be all that are needed to preserve a fragile state of beauty. Should the warnings go unheeded, the ensuing strike may well be enough to secure a moment of safety, no matter how fleeting.

items.name: Histerid
items.description: Capability begets hubris. What might seem invulnerable is rarely more than an illusion, though the despair induced is no less real. The appearance of perfection here is as fragile as the beauty found elsewhere.

items.name: Composite Hull Repairer
items.description: Automated repair system that restores hull integrity over time while activated.

items.name: Stack Slice 530
items.description: The remnants of ancient knowledge brought together once more. Computational life passes through this latticework of restored connections, forming new, twisted shapes of old data. There is no truth here, only stories half-remembered, sifted by the endless churn of time.

items.name: Fusion Head
items.description: A nozzle that burns propellant against a melt-proof liner, throwing a jet hot enough to fuse metal.

items.name: Heat Frame
items.description: A dense conductive block that soaks up heat fast and sheds it slowly, evening out sharp thermal spikes.

items.name: Arc Shroud
items.description: Magnet and conductor coils wound into a cage that holds an electric arc in place and keeps it off its surroundings.

items.name: Chamber R10
items.description: A thick refractory pressure chamber that keeps its strength as the burn inside heats it.

items.name: Chamber R25
items.description: A larger refractory pressure chamber, walled to hold its strength at higher burn temperatures.

items.name: Chamber R50
items.description: The heaviest refractory pressure chamber, walled to hold its strength at the highest burn temperatures.

items.name: Ion Detector (Sensor)
items.description: A large photoconductive plate that turns passing ions into a current, sensitive enough to pick up faint traces.

items.name: Ion Detector (Tube)
items.description: A compact photoconductive plate that turns passing ions into a current.

items.name: Proof Mass (Sensor)
items.description: A heavy, stiff, dense block whose stillness gives a steady reference against which gravity's pull is measured.

items.name: Proof Mass (Chamber)
items.description: A lighter dense, stiff block, used as a reference weight that gravity's pull acts upon.

items.name: Tank Wall (Bay grade)
items.description: A thick metal wall that holds a pressurised fluid without bursting or bleeding.

items.name: Tank Wall (Blister grade)
items.description: A lighter metal wall that holds a pressurised fluid without bursting or bleeding.

items.name: Antenna (Transponder grade)
items.description: A light conductive element that sends and catches radio signals.

items.name: Antenna (Beacon grade)
items.description: A larger light conductive element that sends radio signals far and strong.

items.name: Beam Head (Laser grade)
items.description: An optic, a gain crystal and a heat sink on a frame: it amplifies light into a steady cutting beam.

items.name: Beam Head (Needle grade)
items.description: An optic, a gain crystal and a heat sink on a frame, tuned for a narrow, precise beam.

items.name: Beam Head (Extractor grade)
items.description: An optic, a gain crystal and a heat sink on a frame, tuned to a beam that draws crude out.

items.name: Fuel Stock (D1)
items.description: A hydrogen-rich carrier mixed with oxidiser, ready to burn.

items.name: Fuel Stock (EU-40)
items.description: A heavy crude fraction mixed with oxidiser: dense and slow to vaporise.

items.name: Fuel Stock (SOF-40)
items.description: A light crude fraction mixed with oxidiser: energetic and quick to vaporise.

items.name: Fuel Stock (EU-90)
items.description: Heavy-fraction fuel reworked over a catalyst into a cleaner, stronger-burning stock.

items.name: Fuel Stock (SOF-80)
items.description: Light-fraction fuel reworked over a catalyst into a cleaner, stronger-burning stock.

items.name: Fuel Stock (D2)
items.description: Hydrogen fuel seeded with salt, which steadies its burn.

items.name: Lens Blank (Recycled grade)
items.description: A rough-ground optical blank, ready to be cut and polished.

items.name: Lens Blank (Synthetic grade)
items.description: A clean-grown optical blank, ready to be cut and polished.

items.name: Lens Blank (Needle grade)
items.description: A finely ground optical blank, ready to be figured to a narrow focus.

items.name: Round Charge (Pyro)
items.description: Propellant packed with an incendiary that ignites on impact.

items.name: Round Charge (Slug)
items.description: A plain propellant charge that throws a solid slug.

items.name: Heat Reflector Layer
items.description: A thin metal film that turns radiant heat away before it soaks in.

items.name: Neural Damping Lattice
items.description: A fine conductive mesh that screens out stray fields that unsettle the mind.

items.name: Phase-Stable Wrap
items.description: A crystal lattice that rings at a fixed frequency and holds its wearer steady against time slippage.

items.name: Depot Carrier (Psyche grade)
items.description: A fluid that holds a dose and releases it into the body.

items.name: Depot Carrier (Phase grade)
items.description: A fluid that holds a dose and releases it slowly into the body.

items.name: Coolant Gel
items.description: A volatile gel that soaks up heat as it evaporates.

items.name: Scavenger Catalyst
items.description: A metal catalyst on an inert support that binds and draws off stray traits.

items.name: Signal Wiring
items.description: Fine conductive wire that carries control signals cleanly.

items.name: Conductor Winding
items.description: Coiled metal that carries heavy current or makes a field.

items.name: Magnet
items.description: A permanent magnet that holds a strong, steady field.

items.name: Heating Element
items.description: A resistive element that turns current into steady heat.

items.name: Structural Plate
items.description: A stiff, strong metal plate that bears load and holds a shape.

items.name: Oxidiser
items.description: Oxygen split from water, stored ready to feed a burn.

items.name: Optic
items.description: A clear crystal, ground to pass and shape light.

items.name: Propellant Grain
items.description: A packed charge of fuel and oxidiser that burns fast and evenly.

items.name: Projectile
items.description: A dense metal slug that keeps its momentum and punches through armour.

items.name: Large Cargo Container
items.description: Large sealed storage bay for carrying cargo within the structure. Holds twice as much as a standard Cargo Container. Each fitted module increases the total cargo hold capacity.

items.name: Chamber (Thruster grade)
items.description: A small combustion chamber and nozzle: a refractory wall behind an ablative liner of organic resin and silica that chars and carries the heat away.

items.name: Logic Die
items.description: A small doped semiconductor die etched with logic gates. The faster its semiconductor carries charge, the faster its logic.

items.name: Palladium
items.description:
A rare platinum-group metal used in high-grade alloys and electronics.

Massive Ataxite Matrix is a common source of Palladium.

items.name: Creche Salvage A Loot Container
items.description: A small wreckage container prepared to hold Creche Salvage A.

items.name: Generic Salvage A Loot Container
items.description: A small wreckage container prepared to hold Generic Salvage A.

items.name: Utility Container
items.description: A small wreckage container prepared to hold Utility Component A.

items.name: Sensor Component A Loot Container
items.description: A small wreckage container prepared to hold Sensor Component A.

items.name: Unstable Fuel Loot Container
items.description: A small wreckage container prepared to hold Unstable Fuel.

items.name: Contaminated Neuron
items.description: Extracted from Mycena sensory tissue.

items.name: Industrial Waste Loot Container
items.description: Contains industrial salvage.

items.name: Crystalline Refuse Loot Container
items.description: Contains industrial salvage.

items.name: Debris Loot Container
items.description: Contains ruin salvage.

items.name: Sensor Component B Loot Container
